title: PT Specimen Collector (Observed Collections)
description:
We're looking for an experienced, professional, and outgoing Part Time Specimen Collector for the Raleigh, NC location.

This position involves conducting observed specimen collections for a variable and predominantly female population. Due to the nature of these responsibilities, the role must be performed by a female collector to maintain appropriate collection procedures and privacy.


Schedule: Monday – Friday, 6:15am – 11:00am

Pay: $17.00 per hour

To perform this job successfully an individual must be able to perform each essential duty to a satisfactory standard. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Duties include but are not limited to:

Specimen Collector Responsibilities:

  • Ensure that all patient paperwork is filled out correctly and all necessary information has been captured at the time of the collection
  • Update and maintain patient information and records, as necessary, while ensuring patients complete privacy, observing HIPAA regulations into laboratory information system.
  • Perform and follow specimen (urine, blood, and saliva) collection protocols for specimen collection.
  • Monitor and maintain supplies and supply records for all clinic needs. Communicating to lab any supply requests in a timely manner.
  • Securely and safely package specimens for pick up by the lab's courier service.
  • Follow general work protocols regarding breaks and cell phone usage during business hours.

Education and/or Experience:

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Minimum 1 year of customer service experience

Skills

  • Strong work ethic, commitment to completing assigned tasks and dedicated to high-quality work
  • Outstanding attention to details, ability to multitask and the ability to complete the job without any errors
  • Ability to work with patients in a professional and compassionate manner
  • Ability to communicate well with the clinic's provider and laboratory management
  • Be able to work independently with minimal supervision
  • The ideal candidate has experience in high volume clinical settings observing and obtaining urine samples.

  • Follow general work protocols regarding breaks and cell phone usage during business hours

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer — Crypto Trading Platform (Hybrid)
description:
About Wintermute

Wintermute is one of the largest crypto native algorithmic trading companies in digital assets. We provide liquidity across most cryptocurrency exchanges and trading platforms, a broad range of OTC trading solutions as well as support high profile blockchain projects and traditional financial institutions moving into crypto. Wintermute also has a Wintermute Ventures arm that invests in early stage DeFi projects.

Wintermute was founded in 2017 and has successfully navigated industry cycles. Culturally, we combine the best of the two worlds: the technology standards of high-frequency trading firms in traditional markets and the innovative and entrepreneurial culture of technology startups. To Wintermute digital assets is not just another asset class, we believe in the innovative potential of blockchain, the fundamental innovations, we have a long-term view on the digital asset market and are taking a leadership position in building an innovative and compliant market. You can read more here.

Working at Wintermute

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer who is passionate about building products and applications that people find useful and enjoy using. At Wintermute you will have an opportunity to grow and make a direct impact on trading by developing and improving all the parts of the trading applications for internal and external users — from the interfaces traders and clients work in to the services and APIs behind them — while also getting advice and guidance from very experienced developers and traders. You will get a lot of independence and responsibility right away, and you'll learn at an unprecedented speed.

What will you work on

This role will involve developing end-to-end applications for Wintermute's new trading products and client facing portals, as well as internal trading applications and oversight/project management of corporate website frontend development. You'll own features across the whole stack: designing and implementing backend services and APIs, modelling and exposing trading and market data, and building the frontends on top of them.

A great advantage of this position is to be part of creating and driving the vision for a platform/portal from scratch as well as owning the experience across a range of customer lifecycle stages.

You will work very closely across multiple teams at Wintermute, including product, marketing, trading and engineering. You’ll have an opportunity to improve your knowledge of building high-performance scalable applications, understand broader system architecture and to understand algorithmic crypto currency trading.

We are open to experience from both personal and work-related projects. Interest in algorithmic trading is a plus.


Hard Skills requirements:
  • 5+ years of software development experience across both backend and frontend.
  • Strong backend engineering skills, with Go and/or Python preferred; comfortable designing and implementing services, REST/WebSocket APIs and their data models.
  • Solid working knowledge of the frontend stack: JavaScript and TypeScript, the Node.js/npm ecosystem, and a modern framework — React.js ideally, though experience with a comparable one is fine (please feel free to share any available examples of applications you built).
  • Experience in client-facing financial or other professional services products is preferred but not mandatory (please mention products you worked on and their intended target users); fintech or crypto domain experience is a plus.
  • Good understanding of the infrastructure applications run on: CDN, Cloudflare or similar, web servers, containers, CI/CD, plus basic monitoring and logging.
  • Hands-on experience with a major cloud provider, AWS preferred (e.g. EC2/ECS, S3, IAM, VPC networking, load balancers); infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of relational databases and caching, including schema design and writing efficient queries.
  • Experience developing secure code end to end: strong understanding of common vulnerabilities such as cross-site scripting, cross-site request forgery and other OWASP risks, along with authentication, authorisation and secrets handling, and best practices for testing and mitigating them.
  • Solid grasp of frontend-backend integration, including asynchronous request patterns and streaming real-time data to the browser.
Here is why you should join our dynamic team:
  • Working at one of the most innovative trading firms globally.
  • Engaging projects offering accelerated responsibilities and ownership compared to traditional finance environments.
  • A vibrant working culture with frequent team meals, holiday celebrations, gaming events, and company-wide outings.
  • A Wintermute-inspired office in central London, featuring an array of amenities such as table tennis and foosball, personalized desk configurations, a cozy team breakout area with games and free food.
  • Great company culture: informal, non-hierarchical, ambitious, highly professional with a startup vibe, collaborative and entrepreneurial.
  • A performance-based compensation with a significant earning potential alongside standard perks like pension and private Health insurance.
Note:
  • Although we are unable to accept fully remote candidates, we support significant flexibility in regards to working from home and working hours.
  • We offer UK work permits and help with relocation.

title: 3D FX Lead
description:
At Stellar, we aim to build a studio where people actually want to work. We face productions inevitable ups and downs as a supportive, truly connected team, prioritizing open communication over anyone working in isolation. We value honesty, creativity, and looking out for one another.

The Opportunity:

We are staffing up for a new Marvel Studios streaming series, and we are looking for a talented, empathetic 3D FX Lead who can bring both a strong technical background and a keen artistic eye to the team!

Our 3D FX crew is responsible for conceptualizing and creating dynamic sequences that meet exceptionally high technical and aesthetic standards while keeping the production schedule on track. If you have a masterful understanding of the animation production pipeline, a love for cinematic filmmaking, and the drive to guide a team in producing world class effects, we want to talk to you.

In this role, success looks like:

Leadership and Mentorship

  • Guide, mentor, and support your 3D FX artist, stepping in to help them troubleshoot, solve complex problems, and find clever workarounds to keep their shots moving forward.
  • Partner closely with the FX Supervisor and the broader production team to accurately bid shot complexities and assign tasks based on the strengths of your artists.
  • Run department dailies and team meetings, always looking for ways to improve the FX quality of the show while strictly following the established creative guidelines.

Simulation and Creation

  • Lead by example! Conceptualize and create the most technically demanding hero effects to contribute to the natural and supernatural environments of the show. This includes particles, rigid body and fluid simulations, large and small scale destruction, smoke, dust, lightning, fire, storms, and explosions.
  • Confidently tackle multiple types of digital effects, setting the visual bar for the rest of the department.
  • Bring strong composition, beautiful artistic timing, and a deep understanding of cinematic principles to every sequence you touch.

Problem Solving and Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Pipeline team to solve high level technical issues, share vital intel, and establish best practices for the department.
  • Collaborate seamlessly with upstream and downstream departments to maintain a smooth workflow and ensure the team consistently meets their deadlines.

The Requirements

Must Haves:

  • Experience: 5 plus years of industry experience creating effects simulations in feature films, episodic television, or games, including previous experience guiding or leading artists.
  • Software: High proficiency in Houdini, Maya, and Nuke Compositing.
  • Core Skills: A masterful understanding of the 3D animation production pipeline and exactly how to produce high quality effects that integrate perfectly into a scene.
  • Eligibility: You must be legally eligible to work in British Columbia.

Nice to Haves:

  • Working knowledge of Flow Production Tracking (formerly ShotGrid).
  • A continuous drive to learn new techniques and stay updated on the latest 3D FX software tools.
  • Experience in non-photorealistic rendering (NPR)

Why Join Stellar?

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Extended health, dental, and vision coverage.
  • Culture: A collaborative, ego free environment where your technical expertise and leadership style are truly valued.
  • Compensation: The salary range for this Lead position is between $90,000 and $100,000 CAD per year, based on your level of leadership experience.

At Stellar Creative Lab, we believe diversity and inclusion are key to creativity and collaboration. We’re committed to building a supportive, open, and diverse community where everyone can thrive. We're always looking for ways to improve accessibility, so feel free to share any feedback or suggestions with us.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply, though priority will be given to BC Residents, Canadians and Canadian Permanent Residents.

  • DevOps & Microservices: Help lead the operational side of our highly available microservice architecture.

  • Ability to apply and lead a scientific approach and creative skills to complex problems.
  • Flexible, thrives in diverse team environments, and communicates clearly and precisely.

Preferred Qualifications

We provide training and mentoring for all new team members to fill in any gaps.

title: Lead Software Tools DevOps Engineer
description:
About us

Dyson is a global technology enterprise. We solve the problems others choose to ignore, with surprising new inventions that defy convention and simply work better. We’re driven by progress and thrive on the challenge of relentless improvement. We’re growing fast and our ambition is huge – more categories, more locations and more people. Our scale and rapid growth make Dyson rich in new opportunities. We value new ideas and diverse perspectives, so our people are trusted with real work and responsibility from the outset. You’ll develop fast and have the chance to move into different business areas and regions. And you’ll be part of a global network of like‑minded people – a community that supports and learns from each other.

About the role

As an SDLC Specialist, you’ll be accountable for the day‑to‑day operation, configuration, integration, and improvement of the SDLC toolchain that underpins global engineering teams. This is a hands‑on technical role requiring strong systems thinking, diagnostic ability, and user‑focused problem solving. You will act as a subject‑matter expert for our Source Code Management & Build, ensuring they are reliable, secure, scalable, and aligned to engineering workflows. You will support engineers across multiple programmes, partner closely with Product Owners and DevOps Engineers, and contribute to the evolution of the developer experience.

Accountable for

Tool Administration & Configuration Core Tool Ownership As a tooling specialist, you will own and manage key SDLC tools, maintaining high standards of consistency and governance.

  • Deployment & Configuration of projects, repositories, pipelines, and permission models
  • Managing workflows, schemes, templates, and tool‑specific configuration standards
  • Maintaining tool best‑practice guidelines and enforcing consistent usage patterns
  • Ensuring coherent configuration across teams, products, and regions

Identity & Access Management

  • Configure roles, groups, and permission structures
  • Integrate tools with enterprise identity systems (SSO, LDAP, Azure AD)
  • Enforce least‑privilege access and compliance with audit requirements
  • Support user onboarding and offboarding activities

Integration Across the SDLC Toolchain

Own Tool Integrations End‑to‑End You’ll ensure SDLC tools operate as a connected, cohesive platform, not isolated systems. Key responsibilities:

  • Maintain integrations across: Jira Bitbucket
  • Bitbucket CI/build systems
  • Build systems SonarQube / BlackDuck
  • Build systems Artifactory
  • Monitor integration health and performance
  • Diagnose and resolve cross‑tool or cross‑pipeline failures
  • Data & Traceability Enablement Maintain traceability from plan → code → build → scan → artefact
  • Support evidence requirements for audits, compliance, and release governance
  • Ensure lifecycle data integrity across engineering processes

Operational Support & Incident Management

Day‑to‑Day Platform Operations Monitor system health, logs, utilisation, and performance metrics. Respond to incidents, outages, and service degradation. Perform routine maintenance, patching, and upgrades. Manage backups, restores, lifecycle management, and housekeeping.

Problem Management Conduct root‑cause analysis for recurring or high‑impact issues. Distinguish systemic/tooling issues from user errors. Implement preventative fixes, automation, and configuration improvements.

User Enablement & Support

User Assistance & Troubleshooting Support global engineering teams with permissions, configuration, and workflow problems. Interpret log data and tool behaviours to diagnose issues. Provide guidance on correct usage patterns and best practices. Enablement & Documentation Develop and maintain: How‑to guides, Configuration standards, Troubleshooting documentation. Contribute to onboarding materials and training. Promote and enable self‑service where possible.

CI/CD & Build System Enablement

Pipeline & Build Configuration Configure and maintain standard CI/CD pipelines. Support multiple languages, frameworks, and build technologies. Maintain reusable pipeline templates and shared libraries. Ensure builds are reliable, repeatable, and aligned with engineering standards. Optimise Build Performance Identify bottlenecks across build and pipeline stages. Improve caching, parallelism, and artefact reuse. Reduce build failures caused by inconsistent build environments.

Change, Upgrade & Migration Support Tool Upgrades Plan and deliver upgrades and patches. Validate integrations and behaviours post‑upgrade. Ensure minimal disruption during rollouts. Support rollback paths when necessary. Migration Activities Assist with migrations across tools, instances, or versions. Support repository, project, and artefact migration workflows. Validate data integrity and completeness post‑migration.

About you

Qualification & Skills:

  • Strong hands‑on experience operating and configuring SDLC tools (Jira, Bitbucket, Artifactory, SonarQube, etc.)
  • Expertise in CI/CD principles, build systems, and DevOps ways of working
  • Experience diagnosing issues across toolchains and integrations
  • Knowledge of identity systems (SSO, LDAP, Azure AD)
  • Exposure to scripting for automation (Python, Bash, or similar)
  • Understanding of modern software engineering practices and workflows
  • Ability to work in a fast‑paced, complex engineering environment
  • Good verbal and written Chinese & English skills.

Behaviours:

  • Detail‑focused, reliable, and systematic
  • Calm and structured when troubleshooting critical issues
  • Collaborative, positive, and supportive across global teams
  • User‑centric, approachable, and clear in communication
  • Curious, improvement‑oriented, and proactive in learning

Desirable Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)

Familiarity with SAST/DAST or OSS compliance tooling

Experience with large‑scale tool migrations

Understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, certificates, proxies)

Benefits

Dyson Singapore monitors the market to ensure competitive salaries and bonuses. Beyond that, you’ll enjoy a transport allowance and comprehensive medical care and insurance. But financial benefits are just the start of a Dyson career. Professional growth, leadership development and new opportunities abound, driven by regular reviews and dynamic workshops. And with a vibrant culture, the latest devices and a relaxed dress code reflecting our engineering spirit, it’s an exciting team environment geared to fuelling and realising ambition.

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

Location

Dublin, Ireland (Hybrid/On-site)

Position Summary

Operating directly within our global Product & Technology organisation, this role functions as an internal Forward Deployed Software Engineer. We are looking for an adaptable, highly autonomous senior engineer to tackle rapid prototyping, architectural de-risking, and tactical engineering initiatives. Rather than maintaining a traditional product lifecycle, you will partner closely with our leadership team, including the CTO, senior engineers and architects on short-cycle strategic initiatives. Your customers are Bentley's global Product & Technology (P&T) organization – the teams responsible for building and operating the products and solutions that power our customers' success. You will take on complex, ambiguous technical challenges, rapidly evaluate solution options across the full stack, from architecture and design to hands‑on implementation, build functional proof‑of‑concepts, and transition successful solutions to our core product teams.

Responsibilities
  • Full‑Spectrum Problem Solving: Fluidly navigate across varied technical domains depending on the project. One month you may be addressing deep performance profiling and cloud reliability; the next, you may be building modern front‑end spikes or evaluating microservice patterns.
  • De‑Risk Architecture: Architect, code, and benchmark functional proof‑of‑concepts (PoCs) to validate performance and evaluate emerging technologies before Bentley makes a company‑wide commitment.
  • Operate Across the Stack & Cloud: Leverage a wide range of technologies, acting as a polyglot across multiple programming languages and major cloud platforms to deliver the right solution for the business.
  • Ensure Frictionless Hand‑offs: Package your validated architectures, write the technical summary, and hand the clean, maintainable deliverables over to our global P&T teams so you can pivot to the next strategic unknown.
Qualifications
  • 0‑to‑1 Experience: 7+ years of software engineering experience with a demonstrable track record of designing, building, and delivering complex, high‑performance software in fast‑paced environments.
  • Ownership and Bias for Action: You are highly self‑directed, comfortable operating autonomously without extensive supervision, and driven to turn ambiguity into actionable solutions.
  • Curiosity and Learning Agility: You possess an aptitude to select the best tool for the specific problem at hand. You have working fluency across multiple programming languages (such as C#, TypeScript, Python, Java, or C++) and continuously learn new ones.
  • Empathy and Partnership: You view the global P&T organization as your customer, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring your prototypes are built with their eventual operational needs in mind.
  • AI‑Amplified Output: Practical experience leveraging generative AI APIs, vector retrieval/RAG patterns, or daily integration of AI‑assisted engineering tools to amplify output.
  • High‑Signal Communication: Ability to synthesize complex technical discoveries, trade‑offs, and architectural recommendations into direct, high‑signal summaries for technical leadership.
  • Big Picture Architecture: Solid foundational knowledge of distributed systems, multi‑tenant patterns, containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes), and at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
What We Offer
  • Step into a collaborative work environment where ideas flourish, and teamwork propels us forward towards shared success.
  • An attractive salary and benefits package.
  • Bentley Impact Day: take a day off from work to volunteer with an organization of your choice.
  • Celebrate milestone achievements and moments that matter through our colleague recognition award programs and our Bentley Achievers platform.
  • A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.
  • Be part of a company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world.
  • Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.
Who We Are

Bentley Systems (Nasdaq: BSY) is the infrastructure engineering software company. We provide innovative software to advance the world’s infrastructure – sustaining both the global economy and environment. Our industry‑leading software solutions are used by professionals, and organizations of every size, for the design, construction, and operations of roads and bridges, rail and transit, water and wastewater, public works and utilities, buildings and campuses, mining, and industrial facilities. Our offerings, powered by the iTwin Platform for infrastructure digital twins, include MicroStation and Bentley Open applications for modelling and simulation, Seequent’s software for geoprofessionals, and Bentley Infrastructure Cloud encompassing ProjectWise for project delivery, SYNCHRO for construction management, and AssetWise for asset operations. Bentley Systems’ 5,200 colleagues generate annual revenues of more than $1 billion in 194 countries.

title: Senior Creative Editor (UK Remote)
description:
This is a remote position.

About Project Slingshot
Project Slingshot is a global non-profit working to end factory farming through campaigning, storytelling, culture and creative communications. Our work ranges from social content and celebrity partnerships to documentaries, outdoor advertising and global campaigns.
The Role
As part of the creative team, you will help to produce high quality content and assets that effectively communicate with our audiences. We’re looking for an experienced creative editor who can take a body of raw material, understand what’s really there and find the strongest story within it.
You’ll have a point of view on narrative, structure and pace. You’ll spot the moment that changes the work for the better, knowing when an opening isn’t gripping enough, identifying gaps in the story and suggesting what we need to make it stronger.
Sometimes that means shaping a poignant documentary from hours of footage. Other times it means finding the sharpest 30 seconds for social and making every second earn its place.
We’re not looking for someone who waits to be told where the great moments are. We’re looking for someone who finds them.
What You'll Do
  • Find and shape stories from interviews, rushes, archive and existing content, building strong narrative arcs rather than simply following a prescribed edit
  • Own creative edits from conception to delivery
  • Collaborate with communications, creative and marketing teams
  • Bring references, trends and ideas to the team
  • Create work that grips people, using hooks, emotion, tension, revelation, rhythm and payoff appropriately for each format
  • Keeps an eye on emerging creators, editing styles and formats, ensuring our work feels contemporary, culturally relevant and creatively ambitious
  • Bring exceptional craft to shot selection, pacing, music, sound design, graphics and grade
  • Move confidently between documentaries, campaign films, social content, at times with a fast-turnaround Bring a point of view, improve the story and explain editorial decisions clearly and confidently to senior leadership
  • Create strong motion graphics, typography and titles in After Effects, while recognising when specialist sound, grade, VFX or motion support will make the work better
  • Get under the skin of Project Slingshot and our objectives to help develop an editorial style that feels distinctive, contemporary and difficult to ignore

Requirements

We'd love someone who:
  • Has a portfolio or reel that demonstrates storytelling judgement as well as technical craft.
  • Is highly experienced in Adobe Premiere Pro and confident in After Effects.
  • Understands what makes great long-form editorial and what makes social content stop the scroll.
  • Has strong instincts around music, sound design, colour, typography, composition and pacing.
  • Can work independently with large volumes of material and turn ambiguity into a clear creative direction.
  • Is open to feedback, confident enough to challenge when it matters and able to explain creative decisions with authority and objectivity.
  • Is curious, culturally aware and excited by work that can genuinely make a difference.
  • Is excited to join our mission to end factory farming.

Benefits

Location & Working Pattern
Project Slingshot is a fully remote organisation with flexible working. This role can be based anywhere in the UK. Candidates should have a reliable internet connection. There will occasionally be opportunities and expectations to travel for shoots, team meet-ups and planning sessions.
The Practical Details
  • Location:UK, remote, with some travel for in-person meetings
  • Reports to:Chief Creative Officer
  • Compensation:Annual base salary within the range of GBP 45,000-50,000.
  • Benefits:Paid time off, paid holidays, pension contribution
The Application Process
  • Step 1:submit your application here.
    • You are also welcome to submit a cover letter.
    • A link to examples of work or a portfolio
  • Step 2:our team will review all applications and arrange initial screenings
  • Step 3:shortlisted candidates will be invited to multiple round interviews, and final candidates may also be invited to a paid test exercise
Equal Opportunity
Project Slingshot is an equal opportunity employer. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and lived experiences. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and harassment-free environment where everyone feels valued and supported to do their best work. If you are interested in this role but do not meet every requirement listed, we still encourage you to apply.

title: Assistant Program Manager - Interim
description:
Hope Mission Statement

The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

Position Purpose and Summary

Interim Housing programs provide critical support for people in need, and the work is fast-paced and important. The Assistant Program Manager helps ensure the program runs smoothly every day, making sure operations are consistent and reliable. The Assistant Program Manager tends to provide leadership and presence during Swing shift hours.

Under the supervision of the Program Manager, the Assistant Program Manager oversees staff, ensures rules and contracts are followed, maintains safety and site standards, and takes the lead when the Program Manager is away. This role requires balancing both operational and personnel responsibilities — managing records, compliance, and safety while also supporting staff and participants through challenging situations.

The Assistant Program Manager plays a key role in making sure the program reflects Hope the Mission’s commitment to trauma-informed care, harm reduction, and Housing First principles across every shift, in every interaction, and in decisions.

Program Operations Support

  • Support follow-up on incident reports and participant grievances.

  • Track and update required compliance documentation, including monthly OSHA forms.

Secondary Duties

  • Follow organizational policies regarding attendance, professional conduct, and departmental policies.

  • Perform other program and site related duties as assigned.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage participants, staff, and community partners.

  • Working knowledge of evidence-based service delivery models, including Motivational Interviewing, Harm Reduction, Housing First, and Trauma-Informed Care.

  • Effective staff supervision, coaching, and performance management skills.

  • Knowledge of supportive services program development and implementation within human services environments.

  • Ability to cultivate and maintain collaborative relationships with community-based organizations and external service providers. Strong Interpersonal Skills.

  • Strong understanding of contract compliance, program accountability, and outcomes measurement practices.

  • Strong Emotional Intelligence, Emotional Resilience, and sensitivity towards individuals experiencing hardship.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in social sciences or closely related field; or 2 years equivalent combination of experience and education that provides the applicant with the desired knowledge, skills, and ability required to perform the work.

  • Two to three years of housing and homelessness program-related experience.

title: Sr Database Administrator
description:
Position Summary

The Senior Database Administrator is a senior-level technical role responsible for the architecture, high availability, performance, security, and lifecycle management of enterprise SQL Server database environments. The role serves as the technical authority on database platform strategy, capacity planning, and disaster recovery, and provides mentorship and technical leadership to the Database Administrator team. Partners with the Senior Database Engineer and application development teams to establish and enforce database standards, and leads complex upgrade, consolidation, and migration initiatives.


Primary Duties & Responsibilities

  • Architect, implement, and maintain highly available, secure, and scalable SQL Server database environments across production and non-production tiers.
  • Own the organization's high availability and disaster recovery strategy (Always On Availability Groups, failover clustering, log shipping/mirroring), including planning and leading regular DR testing.
  • Lead capacity planning and performance/scalability initiatives, proactively identifying and resolving systemic performance issues before they impact the business.
  • Establish, document, and enforce database standards, policies, and best practices for security, backup/recovery, monitoring, and change management.
  • Serve as an escalation point for critical database incidents; lead root cause analysis and drive preventive remediation.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional projects such as SQL Server version upgrades, platform consolidations, and cloud migrations (e.g., Azure SQL).
  • Evaluate, recommend, and implement database technologies, tools, and automation (e.g., RedGate, PowerShell, infrastructure-as-code) to improve reliability and reduce manual effort.

Maintenance Bonus $2500 sign on bonus $250 after two weeks no attendance issues. $2250 after 120 days.

We are seeking an experienced Maintenance Technician to help keep our Evansville facility operating safely, reliably, and efficiently. In this hands-on role, you will repair and maintain plant equipment, support equipment installations, complete building maintenance, and assist with the coordination of daily maintenance activities.

This position is ideal for a skilled maintenance professional who stays focused in a fast-paced environment, responds positively to changing priorities, contributes practical solutions, and enjoys sharing technical knowledge with others.

  • Repair and maintain plant machinery and equipment, including mixers, conveyors, compressors, and pumps.
  • Complete work-order repairs, inspections, adjustments, and preventive maintenance activities.
  • Troubleshoot and repair electrical equipment using low-voltage DC and 120-, 240-, and 480-volt AC power in accordance with applicable electrical guidelines.
  • Repair or replace switches, photo eyes, proximity sensors, pushbuttons, contactors, motor starters, and other control devices.
  • Troubleshoot controls to the I/O level and connect to PLC systems so third parties can inspect or troubleshoot programs.
  • Set up and operate welders, drill presses, grinders, hand tools, power tools, and other metalworking equipment.
  • Fabricate and modify new and existing equipment.
  • Support the daily maintenance schedule by helping review staffing availability, priorities, and progress against plan.
  • Recommend equipment, procedures, and long-term solutions that strengthen preventive maintenance and improve day-to-day operations.
  • Help train team members and keep the maintenance team informed about abnormal or critical situations.
  • Promote safe work practices and help ensure employees, contractors, and visitors follow applicable quality and food safety requirements.

  • Three or more years of relevant maintenance experience.
  • A two-year degree in industrial technology or advanced manufacturing is preferred.
  • Experience in a food manufacturing facility is preferred.
  • Strong mechanical repair, general welding, electrical troubleshooting, and PLC troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong electrical controls experience, or the ability to develop that capability within a reasonable timeframe.
  • Ability to use hand tools, handheld power tools, and basic computer applications.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate closely with production and maintenance team members.
  • Ability to work through complex problems and develop logical, practical solutions.
  • Ability to lead by example and help train fellow team members.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

This role works in an industrial manufacturing environment that may include high noise levels, wet floors, steam-related burn hazards, confined spaces, and outdoor temperatures ranging from below 0°F to above 100°F. The position requires frequent climbing, crawling, bending, twisting, and working from ladders or aerial lifts, sometimes at heights exceeding 20 feet.

Team members must be able to regularly lift 25 pounds and occasionally lift 50 pounds, handle long or heavy materials overhead, and apply sufficient force to operate tools and tighten large nuts and bolts. Close, distance, and color vision, the ability to adjust focus, and sufficient hearing to help diagnose equipment issues are also required.

title: Juvenile Justice Oversight Director
description:
Job Title: Juvenile Justice Oversight Director
Work Arrangement: Onsite
Location: Washington, DC 20024
Employment Type: Contract
Engagement Type: W2 or 1099 (No C2C)
Final Interview: In Person

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company (DTLC) is hiring a Juvenile Justice Oversight Director on behalf of the District of Columbia Office of the Ombudsperson for Children (OFC).

Provides independent monitoring, investigation, and reporting on DYRS facilities and services on behalf of the Office of the Ombudsperson for Children, to improve systemic outcomes, safety, and service access for youth in DYRS care and custody.

Project Overview and Objective

The purpose of this contract is to secure the services of a Juvenile Justice Oversight Director to provide independent monitoring, data analysis, and reporting on Department of Youth Rehabilitation Services (DYRS) facilities and services. The objective is to improve systemic outcomes, safety, and service access for youth in the care and custody of DYRS.

Scope of Work and Duties

The Contractor shall independently perform the following duties under the direct supervision of the OFC Ombudsperson, and responsibility to the D.C. Council:

Facility Monitoring and Site Visits

  • Conduct regular, unannounced, and announced onsite visits to YSC, NBYDC, and other local and out-of-area facilities as necessary to ensure youth are housed in constructive environments contributing to their rehabilitation.
  • Evaluate physical facility conditions and document data trends affecting resident youth.
  • Evaluate facility operations against established juvenile justice program best practices.

Complaint Investigation

  • Receive, log, and investigate complaints on an as-needed basis regarding facility conditions and service delivery.
  • Investigate allegations of policy and legal violations affecting youth safety or resource access.
  • Identify themes and underlying systemic reforms necessary to address issue areas found across investigations.

Systemic Reviews and Advocacy

  • Track and monitor DYRS's adherence to requirements of the ROAD Act (Recidivism Reduction, Oversight, and Accountability for DYRS Act of 2024), enacted in February 2025.
  • Track DYRS's progress in achieving Jerry M Work Plan Goals, including critical Work Plan indicators not achieved prior to the Superior Court's termination of the Jerry M lawsuit.
  • Investigate and report on broader, systemic issues identified during routine monitoring, including timely needs assessments and service planning; consult with relevant District agencies and departments to assess structural modifications or service delivery improvements.
  • Track, monitor, and verify all corrective actions implemented by DYRS to ensure compliance.

Deliverables and Reporting Schedule

The Contractor must submit all formal work products to the OFC Ombudsperson for initial review and approval. All formal work products should consider legal requirements, best juvenile-justice practices, and other criteria to objectively and accurately review and assess DYRS's policies, procedures, programs, and practices. These should aim to identify any systemic problems, the reasons for the systemic problems, and, if possible, suggest possible solutions to those problems.

Quarterly Performance Reports: Submitted every three months, detailing:

  • Total number of facility site visits completed during the quarter.
  • Volume, nature, and source of complaints received.
  • Status and descriptions of ongoing investigations or addressed issues.
  • Summary of interagency communications.
  • Corrective Recommendation Documents: created on an as-needed basis to summarize outcomes and outline required DYRS improvement measures, shared with Council quarterly.
  • Public Web Postings: Format and finalize approved reports for timely publication on the OFC website.

Review and Sign-Off Protocol

  • OFC Approval: Contractor submits draft reports to the OFC Ombudsperson for initial approval.
  • DYRS Review Period: Approved drafts are provided to DYRS, giving them the right to review and submit comments prior to submission to the D.C. Council.
  • Council Presentation: The final report, including or addressing DYRS feedback, is formally presented to the D.C. Council.

Contract Administration and Supervision

  • Administrative Authority: this contract is fully administered by the Office of the Ombudsperson for Children (OFC).
  • Supervision: the Contractor reports directly to and operates under the supervision of the OFC Ombudsperson.

Education

  • Bachelor's or graduate/higher-level degree with major study in juvenile justice, social work, or a related field appropriate to the position; experience may include criminal justice, case management, or facilities management.

Requirements

Required and Desired Skills

  • Bachelor's or graduate/higher-level degree with major study in juvenile justice, social work, or a related field appropriate to the position. (Required, 15 years)
  • Maintain confidentiality regarding process and outcomes in accordance with all legal requirements. (Required, 11 years)
  • Demonstrable ability to effectively communicate orally and in writing with internal and external stakeholders. (Required, 11 years)
  • Ability to prepare and present recommendations or solutions regarding complex and extremely sensitive issues, based on analysis and evaluation. (Required, 11 years)
  • Demonstrable advanced comprehensive knowledge of juvenile justice policies and procedures, Federal and District legislation. (Required, 11 years)
  • Conduct thorough DYRS facility assessments and complaint investigations, reaching neutral and objective conclusions. (Required, 11 years)

How to Apply

Qualified candidates should email their resume to talent@dhakatech.us with "Juvenile Justice Oversight Director" in the subject line.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

Phoenix Global is seeking an Electrical, Instrumentation, and Controls (EI&C) Technician responsible for installing, calibrating, maintaining, and troubleshooting complex plant automation systems, field instrumentation, and power distribution networks to ensure optimal operational reliability. This role prioritizes rigorous preventative maintenance and maintains rigorous safety and environmental compliance across facilities. The ideal candidate will safely minimize production downtime while driving continuous technical improvements in a heavy industrial environment.

KEY RESPONSIBLITES:

Safety & Compliance

  • Foster a safe work environment by promoting and adherence to safety protocols, identifying environmental risks, and proactively correcting unsafe behaviors or conditions.

Troubleshooting

E&I Field Maintenance & Calibration

  • Manage the routine inspection, calibration, and predictive maintenance schedules for field instruments to minimize unexpected production downtime and verify measurement accuracy.
  • Seamlessly integrate newly deployed instruments into existing process control systems, preserving full structural loop integrity.
  • Keep accurate records of all field activities, preserving historical logs for PM cycles, instrumentation calibrations, and formal certificates of completion.

Power Distribution & Plant Optimization

  • Provide safe, technical assistance and physical support for low, medium, and high-voltage power distribution networks.

Engineering Collaboration

  • Deep understanding of Historian, OPC (Open Platform Communication) servers, and Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) systems.
  • Ability to interpret and create or modify complex electrical schematics using AutoCAD.
  • Strong understanding of industrial controls, scheduling, risk analysis, constructability reviews, construction, and system start-up.
  • Exceptional written and verbal skills to translate technical data into clear business reports.
  • Advanced user of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and MS Project.

EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS / WORK EXPERIENCE:

  • Industrial Electrician or Technical Graduate with 2- or 4-year bachelor’s degree.
  • Minimum 7 years hands-on experience in related heavy industrial, manufacturing plant environment with progressive responsibility.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

  • Exposure to wet or humid conditions, moving mechanical parts, fumes, airborne particles, and varying outdoor weather conditions.
  • Occasional work in high or precarious places, tight confined spaces, extreme heat, risk of electrical shock, and equipment vibration
  • Typically moderate, but high-noise areas require mandatory hearing protection.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to live and work in the United States (US citizen, Permanent Resident, valid work visa or equivalent)

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The pay range for this position is $108,000 - $135,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, qualifications, skills, and internal equity.

Annual performance bonus target 10%.

In addition to competitive pay, we offer a comprehensive benefits package for employees and their families. This includes health care coverage (medical, dental, and vision), a 401(k)-retirement plan, life and disability insurance, paid time off, and paid company holidays.

We also provide a variety of supplemental programs designed to support overall wellbeing and everyday needs, such as optional life insurance for eligible family members, supplemental disability coverage, legal services, identity protection, critical illness, hospital and accident insurance, tuition reimbursement, chronic condition support programs, a 24/7 employee assistance program, and telemedicine services.

title: Medical Records Specialist
description:
Pets Sanctuary works with veterinary professionals, pet owners, foster families, shelters, and rescue partners to support the health and well-being of animals. Accurate veterinary records are an important part of that work, helping ensure that essential medical information is available when animals need care, move between providers, or enter new homes.

About the Role:
As a Medical Records Specialist, you will manage veterinary medical documentation for animals supported by Pets Sanctuary, including medical histories, vaccination records, diagnostic reports, treatment summaries, and other health-related documents. You will help maintain complete and reliable records by obtaining missing documentation, identifying discrepancies, and ensuring that medical information is handled appropriately and made available to authorized individuals when needed.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Receive, organize, classify, and maintain veterinary medical records for animals supported by Pets Sanctuary.
  • Maintain accurate animal medical histories, including vaccination records, laboratory results, diagnostic reports, medication histories, surgical records, and discharge summaries.
  • Review incoming documents to ensure they are legible, correctly identified, and associated with the appropriate animal.
  • Identify missing, duplicate, outdated, or incorrectly attributed medical documents and arrange for appropriate follow-up.
  • Request outstanding medical records from veterinary clinics, animal shelters, rescue partners, and other authorized sources.
  • Retrieve and compile existing medical documentation for authorized veterinary consultations, referrals, transfers of care, and adoption-related requirements.
  • Track outstanding medical documentation requests and follow up with the relevant parties until the necessary records have been received.
  • Review animal medical histories for gaps in documentation, such as missing vaccination certificates, diagnostic reports, or treatment summaries.
  • Ensure that corrected or updated medical documents are properly filed while preserving the integrity of original clinical records.
  • Maintain appropriate chronological records so that an animal’s medical history can be reviewed clearly and accurately.
  • Handle veterinary records and associated owner or caregiver information in accordance with applicable privacy requirements and organizational confidentiality policies.
  • Ensure medical documentation is shared only with authorized individuals and organizations and is stored, transferred, and retained appropriately.
  • Report suspected record discrepancies, missing documents, or confidentiality concerns through the appropriate channels.

Requirements:
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in medical records, records administration, healthcare administration, veterinary administration, or a related field.
  • Strong organizational skills and excellent attention to detail, with the ability to maintain accurate and complete records.
  • Comfortable working with digital documents, electronic records systems, spreadsheets, and cloud-based storage platforms.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly when requesting documentation and following up with external providers.
  • Ability to review records carefully, identify missing or inconsistent information, and maintain reliable documentation.
  • Understanding of confidentiality and the responsible handling of medical and personal information.
  • Strong follow-through and the ability to manage multiple documentation requests and deadlines independently.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Title: Sr. Product Manager

Location: Remote


Hanwha Vision America (HVA) is an affiliate of the Hanwha Group, a Fortune Global 500 company. HVA is an industry-leading provider of advanced network video surveillance products, including IP cameras, storage devices, and video management systems, founded on world-class technologies. We offer end-to-end security solutions and have achieved global success across a wide range of industry verticals, including retail, transportation, education, banking, healthcare, hospitality, and airports.


Hanwha Vision is seeking a Senior Product Manager (Hardware) to lead product strategy and execution for our B2B surveillance portfolio. Arm Internships require you to be enrolled in a higher education degree.

The internship duration is 6 months, starting in 2027.

French Law requires students to complete an internship agreement (Convention de Stage). This is a tripartite agreement signed by the student, their home university and host organization, that facilitates an internship in France. It is the contract defining all the essential points of the internship: duration, missions, remuneration and benefits, insurance in the event of an accident, etc.

It is preferable that Arm's own template of the agreement is used. Successful applicants will be required to provide contact details of the appropriate university representatives in order to have the agreement signed.

Please note we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the country where the internship is based, without relying on sponsorship by Arm, for the full duration of the internship

title: Product Manager
description:
Build the internal products that keep a nationwide private aviation operation moving.

PlaneSense, Inc., headquartered in Portsmouth, New Hampshire, is one of the nation's leading providers of fractional aircraft ownership and private aviation solutions. For more than thirty years, PlaneSense has delivered a flexible, efficient, and customer-focused approach to private air travel through its managed fleet of Pilatus aircraft. Known for exceptional service, operational excellence, and continuous innovation, PlaneSense helps individuals and businesses access private aviation with the benefits of ownership and professional aircraft management.

We're seeking a strategic, market-driven Product Manager to own the product lifecycle, from discovery to delivery, for the internal products that power our fractional aviation business. These are the tools our operations, scheduling, maintenance, sales, and flight crews rely on every day to move faster and make better decisions. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of internal user needs, business goals, and cross-functional execution, defining product vision and building roadmaps that increase operational efficiency and improve data flow across the organization.

This role is as much about how you work as what you build. You'll run discovery sessions, requirements meetings, and cross-functional syncs constantly — so we're looking for someone who is genuinely curious about how people work, thinks beyond the obvious solution, builds real relationships across teams, and keeps projects and stakeholders organized without letting anything fall through the cracks.

We're also looking for someone who brings a real product practice with them. You should have run the full product lifecycle before — continuous discovery through definition, delivery, and iteration — and be able to establish a rhythm rather than working issue to issue.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Vision

  • Define and communicate a clear product vision and long-term roadmap for internal tools, aligned with company-wide efficiency and data goals.
  • Identify opportunities where better internal systems can reduce friction across scheduling, operations, maintenance, and other business functions.

Product Lifecycle & Process

  • Own the full product lifecycle for internal tools and run it as a consistent, repeatable practice rather than case by case.
  • Establish lightweight discovery and delivery rituals the team can sustain and adapt them as the portfolio and the organization grow.

Discovery & Internal Research

  • Conduct working sessions with internal stakeholders (ops, crew, sales, finance, maintenance) to understand real workflows, pain points, and data gaps.
  • Approach problems with genuine curiosity; dig past the first answer to understand root causes, and bring creative, thoughtful solutions to the table.
  • Assess how peer companies and adjacent industries solve similar operational and data challenges.

Execution & Delivery

  • Translate findings into clear requirements, user stories, and specifications for engineering and design teams.
  • Prioritize a roadmap that balances quick efficiency wins with longer-term data infrastructure investments.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Meeting Leadership

  • Partner daily with engineering, design, and internal business stakeholders to ensure smooth delivery and adoption of new tools.
  • Run meetings that move work forward: set clear agendas, keep discussions focused and on time, and drive toward decisions rather than open-ended conversation.
  • Proactively draw out perspectives from quieter or less vocal stakeholders, not just the loudest voices in the room, to ensure decisions reflect the full picture.

Organization & Process

  • Keep multiple concurrent workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines clearly tracked and communicated.
  • Maintain organized documentation of decisions, requirements, and feedback so nothing gets lost between meetings.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 5+ years applicable experience with managing workflows and lifecycle management, at least 2+ years is Product Management ideally including internal tools, operations/efficiency products, or B2B systems; aviation or other operationally complex industry experience is a plus but not required.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in business, computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Facilitation: Demonstrated ability to run effective meetings: setting agendas, managing time, surfacing input from quiet contributors, and keeping groups focused on outcomes.
  • Communication: Exceptional stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership skills; comfortable working with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Mindset: Naturally curious, comfortable challenging assumptions, and able to generate creative solutions rather than defaulting to the obvious approach.
  • Product Lifecycle: Hands-on working knowledge of the full product management lifecycle, and demonstrated end to end on real products. No certification required; we care that you've done it.
  • Discovery Practice: Practical command of modern continuous discovery methods and the judgment to right-size them for the team and the problem.
  • Methodologies: Comfortable working in Agile and Scrum environments alongside engineering and design.


Why PlaneSense?


At PlaneSense, your work will have a visible impact on a complex, fast-moving aviation operation. You will help shape the tools that connect scheduling, operations, maintenance, sales, and flight crews, improving how teams collaborate and make decisions every day. You will also have the opportunity to establish a strong product practice, influence long-term systems strategy, and contribute to a company known for more than 30 years of operational excellence, customer focus, and continuous innovation.

title: Trust Investigator - Scaled Investigations
description:
At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

This position will be hybrid in LinkedIn’s Omaha, NE office.

About the Team

We are seeking a Trust Investigator to join our Scaled Investigations Team. This role applies investigative tradecraft at scale to uncover coordinated, persistent, and high-impact abuse targeting LinkedIn members, and to drive the resulting enforcement and detection improvements. The work spans detection and mitigation of fake account networks, account takeover and credential abuse, payment and subscription fraud, and the scam infrastructure behind them.

Investigations generally begin with a single lead and expand through pivot analysis across account, device, and behavioral signals. Investigators own this work from the initial lead through enforcement, and surface the detection gaps that allowed the abuse to reach members. Their findings identify the product and model gaps that inform engineering investment.

Investigators on this team work with platform-scale data and have latitude to build their own tooling. We are looking for a self-starter who takes ownership over their work and enjoys being part of a fast-paced, collaborative, global team that values results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead investigations into coordinated campaigns and abuse networks, expanding from an initial lead through pivot analysis across account, device, and behavioral signals.

  • Track persistent abuse patterns and the actors behind them, including how they adapt after enforcement.

  • Proactively hunt for undetected abuse and generate investigative leads using internal platform signals, open-source research, and threat intelligence.

  • Define and validate detection logic from case findings, partner with Engineering, Product teams, and Data Science on implementation, and evaluate detection performance after deployment.

  • Drive large-scale enforcement and takedown actions, including backtesting detection logic, validating targets before enforcement, and measuring false positives after action.

  • Triage and route front-line signals and alerts, and provide escalation support and investigative analysis on high-severity incidents.

  • Produce threat intelligence reports, briefings, and risk recommendations that identify product, policy, and model gaps exposed by investigations and inform strategic investment in our defenses.

  • Use AI-assisted workflows, agents, and notebooks to scale investigation and analysis, and evaluate the quality and accuracy of AI output.

  • Write SQL queries to access and analyze large-scale platform data, identify abuse patterns, test investigative hypotheses, and support enforcement and detection decisions.

  • Build tooling, playbooks, and documentation that scale investigative methodology across the team.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in cyber security, criminal justice or other related technical disciplines, or equivalent technical experience

  • 3+ years of experience investigating account, behavior, or content abuse, preferably within a trust and safety, social media, or online platform context

  • Experience independently writing SQL queries to access and analyze large-scale datasets in support of investigations

  • Experience using Python or another scripting language to automate investigative workflows.

  • Experience with open-source investigation techniques and familiarity with a variety of internet research tools

  • Experience synthesizing complex data sets into clear and actionable insights for diverse audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • BS and 5+ years of relevant work experience, MS and 4+ years of relevant work experience, or PhD and 2+ years of relevant work experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in threat investigations, preferably within a trust and safety, social media, or online platform context

  • A combination of investigative and technical skills, with the ability to define detection logic from case findings and work with Engineering, Product teams, and Data Science to implement detection rules

  • Demonstrated AI skill development, including prompt and context engineering, agent use, and quality and accuracy review of AI output, with a record of applying AI to improve investigative workflows

  • Experience conducting proactive threat and fraud hunting against large scale threats

  • Experience with enforcement at scale, including bulk action preparation and false positive validation

  • Technical acumen and the ability to translate data and investigative outcomes into actionable insights for Engineering, AI partners, and senior leadership

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to inspire and influence across all levels of the organization

  • Familiarity with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and cyber kill chain, and the ability to adapt them to platform abuse

Suggested Skills

  • Trust Investigations of coordinated & complex abuse

  • Platform Abuse Prevention

  • Threat Hunting

  • AI-Assisted Investigation

  • Data Analysis (SQL, Python)

title: Associate Director, Communications and Outrea
description:
Associate Director, Communications and Outreach
Communications and Outreach Department (COM) – Washington State Bar Association (WSBA)

Salary Range: $115,934 to $115,934 + Washington State Employee Benefits and Retirement Plans
FLSA: Full-time, Exempt
Work Location: Hybrid-Commutable within Washington State

The WSBA's mission is to serve the public and the members of the Bar, to ensure the integrity of the legal profession, and to champion justice.

Purpose and Position Summary:

The Associate Director for the Communications and Outreach Department is a bridge between high-level strategic planning and daily implementation of integrated, best-practice communication and outreach campaigns that support the WSBA’s mission, goals, and core initiatives, all while elevating the organization’s reputation and brand.

This position works closely with the Chief Communications and Outreach Officer to ensure messages and communication campaigns cascade down with fidelity across the organization and department while also directly overseeing a team that owns and expertly utilizes the WSBA’s main communication channels, including the website, social media, blog, and bulk email system.

This is a highly visible and diplomatic position, interacting with leaders and dignitaries of the WSBA, the Washington Supreme Court, and the legal community; the media; national counterparts; and, at times, foreign delegations.

Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Department Leadership and Team Management:

  • Serve as a thought partner for organizational leaders and department managers, providing a communications lens for decisions and actions.
  • Drive strategy to lead the department and its managers in staying abreast of best practices, policies, processes, and guidelines, whether in response to organizational needs, best communications practices, or changing technology.
  • Directly manage the Communications and Outreach Team, which includes setting and adhering to an annual budget, managing and mentoring a team of communications practitioners to achieve day-to-day and long-term professional goals, and holding regular team and one-on-one check-ins.
  • Help develop department/team systems and workflows that capitalize on collaboration tools and technology, organize information and resources in intuitive and accessible ways, and keep everyone aligned.
  • Contribute to a positive, inclusive, mission-driven culture, which includes helping to plan department meetings, retreats, and team-building events; and promoting the WSBA’s focus on excellence, integrity, unity, and joy.
  • Serve as the designated proxy and second-in-command for the Chief Communications and Outreach Officer, maintaining oversight of departmental leadership, media strategy, media relations, and executive messaging.

Communication Campaigns and Events:

  • Partner closely with the Chief Communications and Outreach Officer to translate organizational and departmental goals into cohesive and effective communication plans.
  • Collaborate with colleagues in other departments to understand and support their key programs and initiatives.
  • Ensure communication plans and messaging cascade with fidelity across the department’s teams and channels. Guide unique content strategy and timelines for different channels and platforms, including the website, social media, electronic newsletters, the magazine, blog, outreach initiatives, and more.
  • Craft compelling messages and stories, including executive speeches, internal and external presentations, magazine articles, and more.
  • Build and maintain relationships with county bar leaders and, with assistance from the Outreach Specialist, ensure two-way communication between WSBA leaders and county-bar leaders.
  • Project manage several high-profile events annually, including the 50-year service member lunch and summit to support volunteer bar leaders; provide support, such as speech writing and run-of-show planning, for other events.
  • Project-manage the annual member awards process: Chair the Board of Governors Awards Committee, develop and oversee the award bestowal and related assets; implement a communication campaign to highlight excellence and service in the legal community.

Media Relations, Reputation, and Issues Management:

  • Develop public, member, and staff communications strategy and messaging in consultation with the Chief Communications and Outreach Officer.
  • Develop and maintain positive relationships with influential media covering the legal profession, and with local, statewide, and national media.
  • Monitor media inquiries and “hits” and provide an ongoing log for WSBA leaders. Work in collaboration with the Chief Communications and Outreach Officer to ensure timely responses to media inquiries.
  • Counsel and collaborate with WSBA President and/or Board of Governors, Executive Director, Chief Communications Officer, and other members of the Executive Management Team for media statements and comment.
  • Proactively outreach to the media and general public for WSBA core initiatives.
  • Stay up to date on crisis communication best practices and work closely with WSBA leaders to keep emergency plans and processes up to date.

Other Duties as Assigned:

  • Serve as department representative on cross-departmental teams for long-term and ongoing operational planning, as well as short-term and ad-hoc teams.
  • Partner with Human Resources to develop strategies for LinkedIn and Glassdoor.
  • Be nimble and keep learning: The need for support from the Communications and Outreach Department is omnipresent across the organization and can come rapidly and at all hours.
  • Responsible for carrying out disaster recovery measures with COMM department in the event of WSBA declared disaster.
  • Serves as a designated event liaison, a point of contact for offsite or after-hours WSBA events.

Education Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in communications, public relations, journalism, English or marketing (or a related discipline), or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Education Preferred:

  • Advanced Crisis Communication Certificate Program (PRSA).

Experience Required:

  • 7 years of experience in a management level role in communications with direct reports, including:
  • Expertise in developing and implementing strategic communication plans with measurable results.
  • Experience producing and integrating content across various media, such as newsletters, blogs, and speeches.
  • Experience with managing media relations, public relations, or other organizational communications.
  • Experience working with boards and volunteers.
  • 3 years of supervisory experience directly managing team performance, daily operations, and employee relations, or equivalent experience.

Experience Preferred:

  • Experience and/or knowledge of the legal profession.
  • Experience working with a board of a membership organization, and/or in public service or a nonprofit, purpose-driven environment.

Competencies (Skills/Abilities) Required:

  • Ability to think broadly and strategically while executing tactically, paired with clear, professional written and oral communication for diverse audiences.
  • Strong customer service orientation with the ability to interact with a variety of stakeholders with responsiveness and clarity.
  • Organizational skills with the ability to prioritize time and work, manage multiple tasks with competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated strong attention to detail and accuracy across all aspects of this position.
  • Ability to interpret and apply rules, regulations, policies, and procedures.
  • Maintain confidentiality and exercise professional judgement and ethics.
  • Strong editing and proofreading skills, with the ability to create, refine, and integrate content across multiple media platforms—including newsletters, blogs, and speeches.
  • Impeccable judgment and diplomacy as well as alignment with the WSBA’s values: Championing justice, expanding inclusive systems and practices, and serving the legal community and Washingtonians with excellence.
  • Crisis communications and issues-management skills.
  • Understand both high-technology and high-touch strategies to deliver meaningful messages and build relationships with various stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and the ability to learn and use new software and technology platforms, including content management systems and the use of social media as a strategic communication tools.
  • Fluent in leading-edge public relations practices and storytelling.

Competencies (Skills/Abilities) Preferred:

  • Advanced crisis communications and issues-management skills.

Working Conditions:

This is a Hybrid - Commutable position and job duties may be performed in person or remotely. All WSBA staff must be flexible to work in office or travel within WA state as deemed necessary, or as required.

The WSBA headquarters are the primary location while working for the WSBA regardless of where staff may reside within Washington. WSBA does not offer fully remote positions and reserves the right to require employees to work in-person and on-site at the WSBA headquarters or at any worksite necessary to fulfill job duties. For remote work (if applicable), staff must have an adequate work environment and internet access for performing work of a sensitive and confidential nature. Staff are required to use a personal smart mobile device for multifactor authentication via a WSBA authorized App.

Employment with the Washington State Bar Association mandates that WSBA Staff must reside within the State of Washington at the time of hire, and during active employment status.

The essential functions of the job that must be performed, with or without a reasonable accommodation: This position must be able to regularly work WSBA’s business hours in an office type environment (remote or in office), possess the ability to primarily sit/stand and use a computer, and lift/push/pull items weighing up to 25 pounds. Must be able to use standard computer and office equipment (e.g., copiers, scanners, printers, phones, fax, etc.).

WSBA Benefits Include:

  • State of Washington Retirement system (DRS/PERS), including an optional Deferred Compensation Plan (DRS/DCP).
  • Medical benefits (including Rx) through the WA Healthcare Authority, with WSBA paying a majority of the premium cost.
  • 100% paid premiums for employee Dental and Vision.
  • Long-Term Disability and Life Insurance Plans.
  • Generous Paid Time Off Benefits (sick/PSSL, vacation, holiday, float, emergency leave).
  • Transportation incentives, *based on primary work selection requirements.
  • Allowance to set up a home office, *based on a primary remote work selection.
  • Free Employee Assistance Program, and National Employee Discount Program.
  • The WSBA is a Public Student Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) eligible employer.
  • Eligible tuition assistance and continued training programs.
  • Access to a discounted pet insurance program.
  • You will be working with a team of supportive, collaborative, creative, and dedicated colleagues driven to accomplish WSBA’s Mission.
  • A company culture that truly focuses on a quality work and life balance for its staff through our 4 Pillars: 1) Excellence (Mission-driven results), 2) Unity (Team-driven results), 3) Integrity (Value-driven results), and 4 JOY! (People-driven culture).


For consideration and to apply: interested and qualified candidates must apply online and submit the following required materials: both a comprehensive resume and a cover letter (letter of interest) describing your interest and experience in this position. *Applications submitted without a cover letter will be considered incomplete.

WSBA Staff must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis, upon hire. This position is not eligible for Sponsorship.

WSBA administers pre-employment background screening upon a contingent verbal offer, and prior to hire.

The WSBA is subject to Washington State Court Rules General Rule (GR) 12.4, which specifies the Bar’s responsibility and process to provide public access to Bar records.

The Washington State Bar Association (WSBA) operates under the delegated authority of the Washington Supreme Court and exercises a governmental function authorized by the Washington Supreme Court to license and regulate the state’s nearly 40,000 legal professionals, including lawyers, limited practice officers, and limited license legal technicians. The WSBA both regulates legal professionals under the authority of the Court and serves its members as a professional association — all without public funding. The WSBA administers the bar admission process, including the bar exam; provides record-keeping and licensing functions; administers the lawyer discipline system. and provides continuing legal education for legal professionals, in addition to numerous other educational and member-service activities.

The WSBA is committed to fostering a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

The statements contained in this job announcement are not necessarily all-inclusive; additional duties may be assigned, and requirements may vary from time to time.
