title: Analyst - Admissions
description:
Analyst – Admissions
Regulatory Services Department (RSD) – Washington State Bar Association (WSBA)

Salary Range: $59,460 to $59,460 + Washington State Employee Benefits and Retirement Plans
FLSA: Full-time, Non-Exempt
Work Location: Hybrid within Washington State

Application Deadline: 10/18/2026

The WSBA's mission is to serve the public and the members of the Bar, to ensure the integrity of the legal profession, and to champion justice.

Purpose and Position Summary:

The Admissions Analyst applies their knowledge of rules, regulations, bylaws, policies and precedent to fact situations and performs the following duties: reviews and analyzes applications submitted for admission or licensure to practice law in Washington; communicates with and respond to inquiries from the public, applicants and members about the qualifications for a license to practice law in Washington; administration of the bar exams and LPO exams; ensures applicants comply with all regulatory requirements for admission or licensure to practice law; assists the manager with administrative support to the Board of Bar Examiners, including preparing exam answers for grading and releasing exam results.

Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Reviews, analyzes, and processes all application types for admission or licensure to practice law in Washington:

  • Evaluates eligibility, verifying required documentation, and assessing applications for compliance with regulatory requirements, including identifying potential legal, character, or fitness issues requiring further inquiry.
  • Conducts preliminary investigations into applicant qualifications as needed, ensures accurate and timely data entry, and requests and tracks supplemental information such as law school certificates and NCBE reports.
  • Assists applicants with completing pre‑admission or additional licensure requirements, performs character and fitness investigations during high‑volume periods or investigator absences, and prepares complete applications and recommendations for prompt submission to the Court.
  • Issues new‑admittee packets or licensure notifications once applicants are approved.

Communicates with applicants, members, law students, and the public:

  • Serves as a key point of contact for applicants, members, law students, and the public by responding clearly, professionally, and promptly to inquiries throughout the admissions and licensure process.
  • Clearly communicates eligibility determinations and available pathways for admission or licensure, informs applicants about required information and the consequences of failing to provide it, and follows up to ensure timely receipt of needed materials.
  • Supports presentations and informational sessions on the admissions process as needed.

Assists admissions manager with reasonable accommodations requests:

  • Supports the admissions manager in administering reasonable accommodation requests by processing applications, ensuring timely review by appropriate professionals, and coordinating with the admissions manager, regulatory counsel, and the NCBE to secure accommodations and nonstandard exams.
  • Maintains regular communication with applicants to explain requirements, clarify requests, document submissions, and convey recommended accommodations.
  • Collaborates with WSBA consultants to develop and confirm exam accommodations.

Assists admissions manager with administration of bar exams and LPO exams:

  • The position assists the admissions manager in administering bar and LPO exams by organizing and preparing all exam materials and supplies, producing registration materials,
  • Heavily involved in the recruiting and training of Bar Exam proctors.
  • It also coordinates vendor RFPs and contract processing and supports on‑site exam administration, including setup, registration, door security, monitoring, scanning exam answers, and assisting proctors throughout the exam process.

Assists admissions manager with exam grading and results:

  • Assists the admissions manager with all aspects of exam grading and results by proofing and preparing exam answers for the Board of Bar Examiners, supporting grading‑session logistics and attending Board meetings, and coordinating the full exam‑results process, including transmitting and verifying NCBE scores to ensure accurate and timely release.
  • Prepares exam statistics for publication and distributes results to law schools.

Assists the admissions manager with development and maintenance of admissions software and programs:

  • Assists the admissions manager with maintaining and improving admissions software by identifying and verifying user‑interface bugs, coordinating with vendors or WSBA IT for timely resolution, and running system queries and reports.
  • Audits the system to ensure data accuracy, monitors data exchanges with the membership database to maintain data integrity, and prepares and executes user acceptance testing (UAT) for all new system updates or programming.

Provides department administrative assistance:

  • The position provides general administrative support to the department by creating, updating, and maintaining forms, web pages, FAQs, and procedure manuals; managing file maintenance, review, retention, and destruction in accordance with WSBA’s retention schedule; sorting and distributing departmental mail, faxes, and deliveries; and managing offsite records, including maintaining inventories and coordinating retrieval.

Performs additional duties as assigned:

  • This position is required to travel within Washington; and works occasionally evenings and weekends for Bar Exams, etc.
  • Serves as a designated event liaison, a point of contact for offsite or after-hours WSBA events.

Education Required:

  • Associate’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Education Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree with college-level coursework in law or legal education.
  • Paralegal certificate.

Experience Required:

  • 2 years of experience in critical thinking, complex problem-solving, and professional customer service.

Experience Preferred:

  • Experience in one or more of the following:
  • Legal field and/or regulatory environment.
  • Web site page creation and/or editing experience.

Competencies (Skills/Abilities) Required:

  • Clear, professional written and oral communication to a variety of diverse audiences.
  • Strong customer service orientation with the ability to interact professionally with a variety of stakeholders with responsiveness and clarity.
  • Organizational skills with the ability to prioritize time and work, manage multiple tasks with competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Good judgment, decision making, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong analytical skills, sound judgment, and a high level of attention to detail and accuracy in all work.
  • Ability to interpret and apply rules, regulations, policies, and procedures.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise professional judgment and ethics.
  • Works well both independently with minimal supervision and as a positive member of a team.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and the ability to learn and use new software and technology platforms.

Working Conditions:

  • This is a Hybrid - Commutable position and job duties may be performed in person or remotely. All WSBA staff must be flexible to work in office or travel within WA state as deemed necessary, or as required.
  • The WSBA headquarters are the primary location while working for the WSBA regardless of where staff may reside within Washington. WSBA does not offer fully remote positions and reserves the right to require employees to work in-person and on-site at the WSBA headquarters or at any worksite necessary to fulfill job duties. For remote work (if applicable), staff must have an adequate work environment and internet access for performing work of a sensitive and confidential nature.
  • Employment with the Washington State Bar Association mandates that WSBA Staff must reside within the State of Washington at the time of hire, and during active employment status.
  • The essential functions of the job that must be performed, with or without a reasonable accommodation: This position must be able to regularly work WSBA’s business hours in an office type environment (remote or in office), possess the ability to primarily sit/stand and use a computer, and lift/push/pull items weighing up to 25 pounds. Must be able to use standard computer and office equipment (e.g., copiers, scanners, printers, phones, fax, etc.).

WSBA Benefits Include:

  • State of Washington Retirement system (DRS/PERS), including an optional Deferred Compensation Plan (DRS/DCP).
  • Medical benefits (including Rx) through the WA Healthcare Authority, with WSBA paying a majority of the premium cost.
  • 100% paid premiums for employee Dental and Vision
  • Long-Term Disability and Life Insurance Plans
  • Generous Paid Time Off Benefits (sick/PSSL, vacation, holiday, float, emergency leave)
  • Transportation incentives, *based on primary work selection requirements.
  • Allowance to set up a home office, *based on a primary remote work selection.
  • Free Employee Assistance Program, and National Employee Discount Program.
  • The WSBA is a Public Student Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) eligible employer.
  • Eligible tuition assistance and continued training programs.
  • Access to a discounted pet insurance program.
  • You will be working with a team of supportive, collaborative, creative, and dedicated colleagues driven to accomplish WSBA’s Mission.
  • A company culture that truly focuses on a quality work and life balance for its staff through our 4 Pillars: 1) Excellence (Mission-driven results), 2) Unity (Team-driven results), 3) Integrity (Value-driven results), and 4 JOY! (People-driven culture).


For consideration and to apply: interested and qualified candidates must apply online and submit the following required materials: both a comprehensive resume and a cover letter (letter of interest) describing your interest and experience in this position. Applications submitted without this information will be considered incomplete.

WSBA Staff must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis, upon hire. This position is not eligible for Sponsorship.

WSBA administers pre-employment background screening upon a contingent verbal offer, and prior to hire.

The WSBA is subject to Washington State Court Rules General Rule (GR) 12.4, which specifies the Bar’s responsibility and process to provide public access to Bar records.

The Washington State Bar Association (WSBA) operates under the delegated authority of the Washington Supreme Court and exercises a governmental function authorized by the Washington Supreme Court to license and regulate the state’s nearly 40,000 legal professionals, including lawyers, limited practice officers, and limited license legal technicians. The WSBA both regulates legal professionals under the authority of the Court and serves its members as a professional association — all without public funding. The WSBA administers the bar admission process, including the bar exam; provides record-keeping and licensing functions; administers the lawyer discipline system. and provides continuing legal education for legal professionals, in addition to numerous other educational and member-service activities.

The WSBA is committed to fostering a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Yard Hostler
description:
Hybrid’s humble beginnings started in 1997 in the back of a print shop designing, selling, and printing tee shirts. Today, Hybrid is a global apparel industry powerhouse in brand and licensing management. Hybrid provides its expertise and fully vertical operations capability – design, merchandising, development, sourcing, production, and distribution – to a broad suite of branded, licensed, generic, and private label partners. Hybrid’s full-service apparel design and manufacturing expertise extends across the apparel category, including knits, woven tops, bottoms, tees, and accessories.

As our organization has evolved, so has our philosophy of doing business. We have made concerted efforts to remove ourselves from the antiquated approach of other apparel manufacturers and doing things differently has been our focus. We are building a company ethos that breeds innovation, collaboration, integrity, and excellence in customer service.

What is my role?

The Yard Hostler will be responsible for safely operating the yard goat and efficiently spotting trailers within the yard spaces and dock doors for the inbound and outbound departments. This role involves driving, maneuvering, and positioning trailers to and from dock doors and parking areas. The Yard Hostler ensures that trailers are correctly positioned and that yard operations run smoothly. This position will also support warehouse operations with PIT operator tasks as needed.

What You'll Do

  • Trailer Movement: Operate yard goat to move trailers between loading docks and designated parking areas.
  • Trailer Positioning: Back trailers into dock doors and parking spaces with precision.
  • Yard Management: Spot trailers in designated locations within the yard as needed and conduct daily yard checks.
  • Inspection: Conduct pre-shift and post-shift inspections of equipment to ensure proper functioning and safety.
  • Documentation: Complete required documentation for trailer movements and yard operations.
  • Communication: Coordinate with warehouse and dock personnel to ensure smooth loading and unloading processes; update trailers via the yard management system on a tablet.
  • Maintenance: Report any equipment issues or maintenance needs to the supervisor.
  • Safety: Follow all safety protocols and procedures to maintain a safe working environment.
  • Support: Split shift between outdoor yard and indoor warehouse operations, depending on business needs.

What You'll Need

  • Experience: Previous experience as a Yard Hostler or in a similar role is preferred (3 years).
  • Driving: Valid Driver's License

title: Director, PDM Planning & Operations
description:
Risepoint is an education technology company that helps regional universities launch and grow online programs for modern learners. Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Our suite of products and services supports the full student journey and each university’s long-term goals. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com.


The Impact You Will Make


Partner Data Manager (PDM) is Risepoint's centralized database for partner and program information. It is also the mechanism through which Partner Support updates and distributes partner-facing content and resources organization-wide, giving teams one source of truth and helping ensure consistent messaging across Risepoint and with prospective and current students.

As Risepoint's business grows more dependent on PDM, this role ensures PDM evolves deliberately: anticipating business needs, prioritizing the right improvements (including user experience), and powering the transformation initiatives the business has prioritized. You will lead the business direction and roadmap for PDM, translating broader business priorities and the needs of Partner Support, Finance, Marketing, and other teams into a clear, prioritized roadmap. You'll partner closely with Business Technology's Product Owner, who leads technical delivery, while you own the business case, priorities, and the team that keeps PDM running reliably day to day.

How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life

What You Will Do

  • Serve as the business owner for PDM, shaping its multi-year vision and translating Risepoint’s broader business and transformation priorities into a clear roadmap, priorities, and business requirements.
  • Represent the business voice in roadmap trade-off decisions when partnering with Business Technology.
  • Build and maintain a structured intake and prioritization process for enhancement requests, balancing transformation-critical work, UX improvements, compliance/audit needs, and operational fixes.
  • Develop business cases and value justifications (cost, risk, efficiency, user experience) for proposed PDM investments.
  • Identify UX friction points and data/functionality gaps across PDM users and champion improvements through the roadmap
  • Serve as the primary point of accountability for PDM within Partner Support, representing its capabilities, constraints, and roadmap to leadership.
  • Act as liaison to Business Technology on all PDM-related initiatives, escalating and resolving cross-functional roadblocks.
  • Maintain a cross-functional view of how PDM connects to adjacent systems and processes, anticipating ripple effects of a given change rather than evaluating each request in isolation.
  • Own post-release follow-through — checking that changes landed as intended, gathering feedback from affected teams, and feeding lessons learned back into how future changes are scoped and rolled out.

What Success Looks Like

  • A prioritized, business-aligned PDM roadmap is in place and jointly owned with Business Technology's Product Owner.
  • Enhancement requests move through a clear intake and prioritization process
  • Key UX pain points and data/functionality gaps for PDM users have been identified and are being actively addressed.
  • Major PDM releases land with minimal disruption because affected teams were identified, informed, and prepared in advance.
  • undefined
  • Percentage of roadmap items entering Business Technology's backlog with a validated business case, clear priority, and defined success criteria.
  • Breadth of cross-functional input into the roadmap — how many departments actively contribute needs and priorities each planning cycle.
  • Stakeholder confidence — feedback from department heads and business leaders that their needs are understood and genuinely reflected in the roadmap

What You’ll Bring to the Team

Experience That Matters Most


  • 8+ years of experience in business systems, enterprise application management, or product/program leadership, including 3+ years in a director-level or equivalent strategic leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience owning a roadmap or product strategy for a business-critical system, ideally in partnership with a separate technical/IT product or delivery team.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, including experience managing managers.
  • Experience with business case development, prioritization frameworks, and cross-functional stakeholder management at the executive level.

Experience That’s Great to Have

  • Higher education, ed-tech, or partner/affiliate-based business experience.
  • Experience supporting or leading organizational transformation initiatives involving technology systems.

Risepoint is an equal-opportunity employer and supports a diverse and inclusive workforce.

title: Employment Specialist

title: Medarbejder til lager og vareudlevering - Næstved
description:
Medarbejder til lager og vareudlevering

Bilka ønsker at skabe tilfredse kunder og en fremragende indkøbsoplevelse for alle. Vi stræber efter at gøre hver dag speciel for vores kunder med formålet: Vi inspirerer til flere værdifulde øjeblikke. Gennem vores udvalg, konkurrencedygtige priser og engagerede medarbejdere skaber vi en indkøbsoplevelse, der både opfylder behov og bringer glæde. Vil du være med til at skabe inspirerende oplevelser for Bilkas kunder? Så er du måske Bilkas næste medarbejder til lager og vareudlevering.

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

Som medarbejder i Bilka – uanset niveau – bliver du en del af et solidt fællesskab med gode kolleger. Du indgår i et team, hvor holdånden er høj, og du er en del af fællesskabet i hele butikken og virksomheden.

Du får værdifuld erfaring, som du kan tilføje dit CV. Du lærer at navigere i dagligdagen i en detailbutik, arbejde selvstændigt, men samtidig også samarbejde med dine kolleger, om de bedste løsninger.

Med vores digitale medarbejderapp har du altid din vagtplan ved hånden, samt adgang til informationer og personalegoder. Vi bestræber os på, at din vagtplan passer med eventuel studie og fritidsaktiviteter.

Som medarbejder til lager og vareudlevering bliver du mødt af en varieret arbejdsdag, hvor du håndterer forskelligartede opgaver, nogle alene og andre sammen med dit team.

Bilka er meget mere end det, kunderne ser. Bag facaden ligger vores lager, der altid summer af aktivitet, og hvor vi samarbejder så vores kunder kan få de varer med hjem, som de er kørt til os efter. Vi skal fungere glat og effektivt – og ikke mindst sikkert – når vi modtager varer og sikrer deres tilgængelighed på lageret, så varehuset altid fremstår velopfyldt. Kort sagt fungerer vi bedst, når kunderne slet ikke tænker over, at vi eksisterer.

I vareudleveringen har vi dagens sidste chance for at give kunderne en god oplevelse, inden de lægger deres indkøb i bilen og kører hjem, så vi skal minimere ventetiden og vise kunden service i verdensklasse. Hver gang.

Hvad bringer du med dig?

Vi leder efter dig der har en venlig og imødekommende personlighed. Og så er vi på udkig efter dig, som gerne giver dine kolleger en ekstra hånd, når I sammen leverer den fælles indsats, der skal til, for at I med stolthed kan tage godt imod kunderne i afdelingen. Med dit gode overblik tager du gerne ejerskab – og også lederskab, hvis der er behov for det.

Der kan være mange veje ind i jobbet, og vi er åbne overfor forskellighed. Derfor opfordrer vi kandidater med forskellige baggrunde til at søge.

Griber du chancen?

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send os din ansøgning med det samme gennem linket her på siden. Vi screener og kalder til samtaler løbende.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Bilka er et hypermarked i konstant vækst. Vi har en brændende ambition om at være den mest attraktive arbejdsplads i dansk detailhandel. Så grib chancen, realiser dit potentiale og få 9.500 motiverede kolleger, der slet ikke kan lade være med at udvikle og forbedre.

title: Systems Engineer - CCTV Infrastructure Specialist
description:
Black & Grey HR is recruiting for a leading technology solutions and services provider in Doha, Qatar. Our client is looking to hire a Systems Engineer -CCTV Infrastructure Specialist who will be responsible forthe design, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of CCTV surveillance systems and hyper-converged infrastructure (HCI) to ensure reliable, high-availability video monitoring and core infrastructure services. This role focuses on integrating robust server technologies, database management, clustering solutions, and cloud integration to support secure, scalable video storage and retrieval operations across sports venues. The specialist will collaborate with security, IT operations, and compliance teams to minimize downtime, enhance system performance, and mitigate risks.

Responsibilities CCTV System Management and Maintenance
  • Oversee day-to-day operations of CCTV infrastructure, including hardware, software, and network components, to ensure continuous surveillance coverage and data accessibility.
  • Perform routine health checks, updates, and patching on CCTV servers and storage systems.
  • Monitor system performance metrics using tools like Windows Performance Monitor and SQL Server Management Studio.
  • Troubleshoot hardware failures, network latency issues, and integration problems with video management software (VMS).
  • Implement backup and recovery procedures for video archives to prevent data loss.
HCI Infrastructure Design and Operations
  • Design, deploy, and maintain hyper-converged infrastructure (HCI) clusters supporting CCTV and core venue services.
  • Configure and manage virtualization platforms (e.g., Hyper-V, VMware) for scalable video and infrastructure workloads.
  • Optimize cluster resources, including shared storage (SAN/NAS) and network load balancing for video streaming and infrastructure services.
  • Perform firmware and software updates for HCI nodes.
  • Ensure high availability and rapid failover for mission-critical systems.
High-Availability Infrastructure Design
  • Design and maintain failover clustering and Always On availability groups for SQL databases supporting CCTV video metadata and storage.
  • Set up and test Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC) for redundant CCTV and HCI server nodes.
  • Conduct regular failover drills and recovery time objective (RTO) assessments.
  • Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans specific to surveillance and infrastructure systems.
Windows Server & Security Administration
  • Administer Windows Server environments hosting CCTV and HCI applications, focusing on security hardening, performance tuning, and compliance.
  • Deploy and manage Windows Server roles such as Hyper-V for virtualized environments and Active Directory for user access controls.
  • Apply Group Policy Objects (GPOs) and security baselines, including encryption for video data at rest and in transit.
  • Integrate CCTV and HCI systems with SIEM tools for logging and alerting on security events.
Cloud and Infrastructure Services Integration
  • Integrate CCTV and HCI infrastructure with cloud platforms for hybrid storage, backup, and disaster recovery.
  • Manage cloud-based resources (VMs, storage) related to surveillance and infrastructure services.
  • Ensure compliance with cloud security and cost management policies.
  • Support cloud migration and hybrid operations for video and infrastructure workloads.
Risk Management and Compliance
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate risks related to CCTV and HCI infrastructure.
  • Ensure adherence to data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, local surveillance laws) and organizational standards.
  • Collaborate with compliance teams to audit access logs and ensure video data handling meets legal requirements.
  • Document incidents, root cause analyses, and remediation actions for post-event reviews.
Requirements Experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in IT infrastructure management, with at least 2 years focused on surveillance or video systems and HCI.
  • Proven track record in deploying and troubleshooting high-availability environments in enterprise settings.
  • Experience working in a 24/7 operational environment, including on-call rotations for critical system support.
Education & Certifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (or equivalent).
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate (preferred for cloud-integrated CCTV solutions).

description:

Five Reasons to Work with Us:

  1. Work with a leader in financial services industry
  2. Supportive & flexibleremoteorhybridenvironment

  4. Fast paced growing company
  5. A company that cares with community service efforts

What You Will Be Doing:

The Database Administrator (DBA) is responsible for providing operational andapplication database services to the organization. Primary responsibilitiesinclude owning, tracking, and resolving database-related incidents and requests;monitoring and maintaining database health through backups, maintenance jobs,and index management; and supporting performance and security requirements.

This role involves daily monitoring to identify and address service-relatedissues, responding to database alerts and escalations, and collaborating withmanagement and other teams on solutions to recurring problems. The DBA rolerequires a service-oriented mentality and a high sense of ownership. The DBAis expected to continually look for areas of improvement in projects, products,and processes to ensure efficiency, consistency, and accuracy. Self-directionand the ability to manage and allocate your time across multiple simultaneousprojects are keysforsuccess.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, create, and maintain database objects including indexes, views, stored procedures, tables, and other schema elements inon-premiseand cloud environments.
  • Monitor and maintain database health by reviewing and responding to backup status, maintenance jobs, index health, and daily operational alerts.
  • Perform database user and security management: create logins and users, manage roles and access privileges, and support compliance requirements.
  • Plan, implement, and maintain backup, restore, and recovery procedures; verify backup success and support restore testing.
  • Participate in investigation and resolution of database incidents including blocking, deadlocks, and performance degradation.
  • Optimize existing queries and procedures; develop efficient T-SQL using execution plans, system views, and indexing best practices.
  • Refresh development and test environment databases on a regular basis to support QA and development teams.
  • Assist in building and maintaining database monitoring infrastructure for alerting, performance data collection, and operational visibility.
  • Support implementation of database changes and code deployments; work with the Architecture team on coding standards for stored procedures, triggers, and schema design.
  • Perform feasibility studies and effort estimates for new or revised database systems to address business needs.
  • Install, upgrade, and maintain database instances required for development, testing, and production usage.
  • General technical troubleshooting and consultation with Quality Assurance, Application Development, and Infrastructure teams.
  • Work with multiple departments including Architecture, Quality Assurance, Application Development, and Infrastructure to implement and maintain database code and configurations.

You’ve Got What It Takes If You Have:

  • 3+ years of database administration, development, or equivalent experience
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server 2016 or higher
  • Strong T-SQL skills including complex queries, stored procedures, transaction management, error handling, and dynamic SQL
  • Understanding of execution plans and query optimization techniques
  • Working knowledge of database backup, recovery, and HADR concepts
  • Familiarity with cloud database services in Azure such as Azure SQL MI, Azure SQL DB, or Azure SQL on VMs
  • Experience with database security administration such as user management, role assignment, and access controls
  • Ability to build and maintain SQL scripts, indexes, and complex queries for data analysis and operational use
  • Strong understanding of database structures, theories, principles, and practices for OLTP environments
  • Proven analytical ability and attention to detail in a production environment
  • Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively with development teams in a dynamic environment
  • Commitment to quality and accuracy

Nice To Have:

  • Experience with PowerShell for scripting and operational automation
  • Familiarity with database monitoring and dashboard tools such as SSMS, Grafana, or similar platforms
  • Experience with SSIS or other ETL tooling
  • Experience with SSRS or other managed reporting platforms
  • Familiarity with Git or other version control processes
  • Familiarity with other database platforms such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, or MySQL
  • Familiarity with SOC 2, FINRA, or other regulated industry compliance requirement
  • B.E. or B.S. Degree in one of the following subject areas: Computer Science, Business Administration, Information Technology or related field; related work experience can be substituted for education requirement

The Process:

We can hire in the following states:Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas and Utah.

Any communications related toopenRegEd positions will come from a RegEd.com email address. We do not hire through textmessage, social media, or email alone. Our interviews are conducted either in person or via video calls. We will not ask you for sensitiveinformationnor will we ask you to pay anything during the hiring process.

  • Apply! (3-25 minutes)

Welcome to RegEd!

The Perks:

  • Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability and Long-Term Disability plans
  • Volunteering Time Off and Flexible Schedules
  • 401(k) plan
  • Incredible career growth opportunities

If you are interested in joining a market leader and innovator poised for exponential new business growth in the coming years, please apply. It’s a great time to join the RegEd Team!

Pay Transparency:

The compensation range for this position is $85,000-$120,000.

RegEd takes a market-based approach to pay. It is not typical for a candidate to be hired close to or at the maximum of the salary range. Your actual pay at RegEd is based on your unique background, pertinent experience, worklocationand qualifications. Base pay also depends on the relative experience, knowledge and skills to our internal peers in the role. In addition to competitive base pay and bonus/commission program participation,RegEd’s total compensation package also includes our comprehensive benefits package in addition to vacation, sick, volunteer time off and paid parental leave.

title: APRN-Psych- Outpatient Community Health
description:
Join a Team That Makes a Difference at Optimus Health Care!

Are you passionate about providing high-quality, patient-centered care? Optimus Health Care—the largest provider of primary health care services in Fairfield County—is looking for dedicated professionals to join our team! With multiple locations in Bridgeport, Stratford, and Stamford, our mission is to be a lifelong health care partner, dedicated to achieving optimal wellness for the communities we serve.

Optimus is currently looking for an experienced Psychiatric APRN to join our Behavioral Health team and provide care to our medically complex adult and adolescent patient population in an outpatient setting and in an Intensive Outpatient ( IOP) setting. This position is Monday through Friday with no weekend or call responsibilities.

POSITION SUMMARY

Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner is a member of the mental health care team in a health care system. The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner specializes in psychiatric/mental health providing mental health services. The responsibilities of a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner include but are not limited to conducting comprehensive assessment of personal, medical/ substance abuse and diagnosis, counseling, prescribe medication, ordering and interpreting diagnostic studies for people of all ages with mental illness or mental distress, such as schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, psychosis, depression, or dementia. In addition, the Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner establishes and manages treatment plans to address the individual mental health care needs of a diverse population.


FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Provides comprehensive assessment, plan development, implementation of plan of care and evaluation of effectiveness of interventions with revisions, as necessary.
  2. Initiate, monitors, alters medications and treatments according to approved protocols. Demonstrates thorough understanding of all requirements and practice standards relating to the prescription, administration of medications including compliance with organization policy and procedures, documentation, requirements, medication education.
  3. Monitors medication and initiates appropriate therapies for certain conditions and changes medications according to variations in a patient's response within established protocols.
  4. Observes and differentiates between signs and symptoms associated with normal human physiology and those indicative of pathological changes.
  5. Documents all relevant patient care issues in patients' progress notes and treatment plan all relevant patient care issues.
  6. Includes the use of seclusion and restraint when appropriate and alternative interventions, documentation requirements, disaster and fire procedures, infection control, risk management.
  7. It is sensitive to cultural diversity issues, treats patients as an individual, and considers the culture of the patients when providing care and treatment.
  8. Provides individualized care and treatment that is consistent with/sensitive to the age and life span developmental needs of each patient.
  9. Ensures progress note and treatment plan documentation is in specified format, problem oriented, corresponds to the therapeutic order
  10. Adheres to the established formulary for therapeutic regimens before using non-formulary procedures
  11. Supports standards of psychiatric care through adherence to existing policies and procedures
  12. Assumes responsibility and accountability for his/her individual judgments and actions

Optimus Health Care, Inc. will provide quality assurance protocols and adequate monitoring of the tasks delegated by any or all of the following:

  1. Onsite supervision and consultation between the non-physician practitioner and an available physician with the department.
  2. Charts of Psychiatric Advanced Practice Registered Nurse will be reviewed and audited on an ongoing basis as determined by the Medical Director
  3. Case consultation time shall always be available and special times to discuss and review cases shall occur at regularly scheduled intervals as determined by the Medical Director

JOB QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS

EDUCATION: Graduate of an accredited school of nursing and successful completion of an approved Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner program.

EXPERIENCE: One-three years’ experience in an outpatient setting. Familiarity with telepsychiatry and prior experience a plus

LANGUAGE SKILLS: Bi-lingual skills in Spanish preferred

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: Knowledge of professional nursing theory, practice, and medical care to give and evaluate patient care. Knowledge of organizational policies, regulations, and procedures to administer patient care. Knowledge of medical equipment and instruments to administer care. Knowledge of common safety hazards and precautions to establish a safe work environment. Skill in applying and modifying the principles, methods, and techniques of professional nursing to provide ongoing patient care. Skill in taking medical history to assess medical conditions and interpret findings. Skill in preparing and maintaining records, writing reports, and responding to correspondence using current electronic media. Skill in developing and maintaining quality control/assurance standards. Ability to react calmly and effectively in emergency situations. Ability to interpret, adapt and apply guidelines and procedures. Ability to communicate clearly

title: Operations Associate - Picking
location: Netherlands, Alphen aan den Rijn, Zuid-Holland, NL
description:
Voor ons Support Team in Alphen zijn wij op zoek naar een:


Operations Associate

Picking



Ben jij nauwkeurig, energiek en houd je van aanpakken? Wil je werken in een internationale omgeving waar geen dag hetzelfde is en waar jouw werk direct bijdraagt aan het wereldwijd operationeel houden van vliegtuigen? Dan maken wij graag kennis met jou!


Jouw rol:

Als Operations Associate speel jij een cruciale rol binnen het logistieke proces van Proponent. Vanuit ons warehouse in Alphen aan den Rijn zorg jij ervoor dat vliegtuigonderdelen op het juiste moment op de juiste plek beschikbaar zijn. Daarmee draag je direct bij aan het tijdig leveren van onderdelen aan luchtvaartmaatschappijen over de hele wereld.


En geloof ons: geen onderdeel is hetzelfde. Ons assortiment varieert van boutjes, moertjes en zwemvesten tot complete businessclass-stoelen en andere vliegtuiginterieuronderdelen. Juist die enorme diversiteit maakt het werk afwisselend en uitdagend.


In deze veelzijdige functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor voorraadbeheer, het correct opslaan en verplaatsen van onderdelen en het verzamelen van materialen voor internationale zendingen. Je werkt nauwkeurig, denkt vooruit en zorgt ervoor dat alles soepel verloopt in het warehouse.

Tellen en controleren vormen een belangrijk onderdeel van je werkzaamheden. Je houdt je bezig met cycle counts en fysieke inventarisaties van uiteenlopende onderdelen, van grote verlichtingstrips tot de kleinste vliegtuigbouten. Daarnaast werk je wekelijks mee aan het project Weight & Dimensions, waarbij je afmetingen en gewichten van onderdelen controleert en registreert. Jouw nauwkeurigheid zorgt ervoor dat onze systemen betrouwbaar blijven en onze klanten op onze dienstverlening kunnen vertrouwen.


Je komt terecht in een omgeving die continu in ontwikkeling is. Zo zijn we bezig met de implementatie van een wereldwijd Warehouse Management System, waarbij jij en je collega's als eersten met nieuwe processen en technologieën werken. Ook staat continu verbeteren centraal binnen onze organisatie en werken we volgens de Lean-methodiek. Goede ideeën worden gewaardeerd en jouw input kan daadwerkelijk het verschil maken. In deze functie rapporteer je aan de Supervisor van het Support Team.


Je bent onze ideale kandidaat als je:

  • Een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel hebt en eigenaarschap toont;
  • Nauwkeurig werkt en oog hebt voor kwaliteit;
  • Een echte teamspeler bent die graag collega's ondersteunt;
  • Initiatief neemt en proactief meedenkt over verbeteringen;
  • Fysiek fit bent en graag actief bezig bent;
  • Geen negen-tot-vijf mentaliteit hebt;
  • Ervaring hebt met een reachtruck en/of heftruck;
  • De Nederlandse én Engelse taal goed beheerst.


Heb je daarnaast ambities om door te groeien? Mooi! Binnen Proponent krijg je volop kansen om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en nieuwe stappen in je carrière te zetten.


Nog even praktisch: Je werkt van maandag tot en met vrijdag. De werktijden worden in overleg vastgesteld. Voor deze functie is een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) vereist. Daarnaast verzorgen wij de benodigde trainingen zodat jij goed voorbereid aan de slag kunt.


Wat bieden wij jou:

  • Een uitdagende functie binnen de wereldwijde marktleider in onafhankelijke distributie van vliegtuigonderdelen;
  • Een salaris rond € 2.900 bruto per maand, aangevuld met vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding;
  • Een aantrekkelijke winstdelingsregeling en goede pensioenregeling;
  • Beloningen en credits voor het aandragen van verbeterideeën;
  • ESOP: Proponent is volledig eigendom van haar medewerkers, waardoor iedere medewerker aandeelhouder is;
  • Toegang tot ons e-learningplatform Flight School en volop ontwikkel- en doorgroeimogelijkheden;
  • Gratis fruit, verse soep en uitstekende bonenkoffie;
  • Regelmatig leuke activiteiten en natuurlijk af en toe een gezellig bittergarnituurtje;
  • Een informele, internationale werkomgeving met enthousiaste collega's.
  • Werken in de leukste werkomgeving die er is, namelijk “logistiek”!


Over Proponent:

Proponent is wereldwijd de grootste onafhankelijke distributeur van vliegtuigonderdelen. Wij vormen de onmisbare schakel tussen leveranciers en luchtvaartmaatschappijen en leveren dagelijks duizenden onderdelen over de hele wereld. Bij ons staat kwaliteit centraal. Met het motto "One Time Right" streven we ernaar om onze klanten altijd op tijd en foutloos te bedienen. Dankzij de kennis, ervaring en inzet van collega's uit verschillende landen blijven we groeien en investeren we continu in onze mensen. Onze medewerkers kenmerken zich door hun betrokkenheid, vakmanschap en passie voor logistiek en luchtvaart.


Interesse?

Ben jij enthousiast geworden of ken je iemand die perfect bij deze functie past? Solliciteer dan via het ADP Career Center of kijk op


Wij kijken uit naar je reactie! ✈️📦

About the company:

title: Client Service Monitor
description:
Hope Mission Statement

The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

Position Purpose and Summary

The Client Services Monitor (CSM) works directly on-site and is responsible for keeping participants safe, supporting daily operations, community standards and helping Hope the Mission's Interim Housing programs run smoothly. The CSM plays an important role in creating an environment that is safe, structured, and respectful — one where every participant is treated with dignity and fairness.

This position requires someone who shows up consistently, uses good judgment, and genuinely cares about serving people experiencing homelessness. Many participants in our programs have been through long periods of instability, crisis, and trauma. When a CSM shows up with calm, care, and compassion, it creates a sense of safety and routine that participants can count on as they work toward stable housing.

The CSM reports to the Program Manager or Assistant Program Manager and works alongside site staff to make sure the program runs well, meets contract requirements, and reflects Hope the Mission's values in every interaction.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Facility Maintenance and Sanitation

  • Assists with and facilitates routine cleaning of all facility areas to maintain cleanliness, safety, and operational readiness

  • Cleans and disinfects restrooms and shower areas after each use, without exception. Maintains sanitary and safe restroom and sink conditions at all times. Completes deep cleaning of restrooms and common areas.

  • Monitors and maintains hygiene areas and community areas; ensures resources are fully stocked, replenishing as needed.

  • Washes, dries, and prepares towels used for restroom and shower services

  • Monitors laundry rooms, restrooms, and common areas to ensure cleanliness and appropriate use

  • Maintains accurate shower and restroom usage logs

Participant Safety and Monitoring

  • Conducts required wellness checks each shift to ensure participant safety and well-being

  • Monitors participant movement, common areas, and site activity to promote safety and program compliance

  • Conducts routine site walk-throughs and safety checks during assigned shifts

  • Supports contraband control and safety procedures in accordance with agency policy

  • Responds to incidents and emergencies using trauma-informed de-escalation techniques and follows all incident reporting protocols

  • Supports emergency responses — including medical emergencies, overdoses, and evacuations — until leadership or first responders arrive

Participant Services and Engagement

  • Provides direct, respectful assistance to participants, including answering questions, responding to requests, and connecting participants to appropriate staff or resources

  • Assists with participant intake, orientation, and explanation of site guidelines as directed by management

  • Distributes hygiene supplies including soap, shampoo, towels, and related items to participants as needed

  • Supports meal service, supply distribution, and general operational duties as assigned

Documentation and Reporting

  • Completes Daily Activity Reports (DARs) accurately, objectively, and in a timely manner

  • Conducts intake, exit, and case notes in HMIS where applicable

  • Assists with documentation related to participant movements, wellness concerns, or incidents as required

  • Observes and reports safety concerns, maintenance issues, guideline violations, and unusual occurrences to site leadership promptly

Shift Operations

  • Provides support during shift pass-downs and communicates relevant updates between shifts

  • Provides overnight, evening, weekend, or holiday coverage as scheduled

  • Performs other duties as assigned

Transportation (Site Specific)

  • Transports participants to and from established routes and as directed by a supervisor

  • Maintains vehicle cleanliness inside and out at all times

  • Ensures the vehicle has sufficient fuel before and during each shift

  • Completes daily vehicle maintenance checks and reports any issues to the supervisors

  • Logs all mileage accurately and in accordance with departmental procedures

Skills

  • Strong observation and situational awareness skills

  • Trauma-informed communication and de-escalation techniques

  • Ability to maintain professional boundaries with participants

  • Clear, objective, and professional written documentation skills

  • Ability to follow policies, procedures, and chain of command

  • Strong teamwork and communication skills

  • Basic computer and email proficiency

  • Ability to lead with integrity and uphold organizational mission, values, and service philosophy.

  • Ability to cultivate and maintain collaborative relationships with community-based organizations and external service providers. Strong Interpersonal Skills.

  • Maintains professionalism, empathy, and sound decision-making when working in complex or emotionally challenging environments.


Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required

  • Previous experience in homeless services, shelter operations or social service preferred

  • Knowledge of trauma-informed care and harm reduction principles preferred

  • Ability to work flexible schedules including nights, weekends, and holidays


Mandatory Requirements

  • Background Screening – Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of background checks as required per worksite.

  • Drug and Alcohol Testing – Candidates must pass pre-employment and ongoing drug and alcohol screenings in accordance with company policy.

  • Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) Check – For roles requiring driving, employment is contingent upon an acceptable driving record.

  • Legal Eligibility to Work – Candidates must provide proof of legal authorization to work in the US.

  • Compliance with Company Policies and HIPAA standards – All employees must comply with company policies, including safety, confidentiality, and conduct standards.


Physical, Demands, Environmental Conditions, Equipment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions. The employee is required to: walk and climb stairs; stand, bend, squat, climb, kneel, and twist on an intermittent or sometimes continuous basis; grasp, push, pull objects such as files, file cabinet drawers, and reach overhead; handle, finger, grasp and feel objects and equipment; reach with hands and arms; be mobile by moving oneself from place to place quickly and easily; repeat various motions with the wrists, hands, and fingers; be able to perform visual activities for (including, but not limited to) administrative and clerical tasks; ability to lift up to 25 lbs.; communicate, receive and exchange ideas, information by means of the spoken and written word; drive vehicles in and around Los Angeles County; be able to enter various buildings that may require climbing stairs; be periodically subjected to outside environmental conditions. The employee may work in proximity to service animals and emotional support animals; use a desktop and/or laptop computer; various office machines. Complete all required forms in personal writing.


Work Environment

The employee may be in contact with individuals and families in crisis who may be ill, using alcohol and drugs, and who may not be attentive to basic personal hygiene, health and safety practices. The employee may experience a number of unpleasant sensory demands associated with the participants’ use of alcohol and drugs, and lack of personal hygiene. title: Technical Project Manager (Efector Development)
description:
As Destinus scales its vehicle programmes, we are looking for a dedicated Technical Project Manager to own execution across the full vehicle development stack – from propulsion and structures through avionics integration, ground support equipment, and qualification. This frees our engineers to focus on technical depth and our team leads on strategic leadership.

As one of the first hires in this group, you will manage a programme and help build the PM structure itself alongside team leads and fellow TPMs. You own execution – schedule, cross-disciplinary coordination, risk, and delivery. The engineers run the technical depth; you run the programme.

What You’ll Do

· Own end-to-end execution of vehicle-level and subsystem product development programmes – from kick-off through hardware build, test campaigns, qualification, and delivery

· Build and maintain programme plans spanning propulsion, structures, avionics, systems engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and regulatory dependencies; identify and resolve critical path risks early

· Run programme reviews and cross-functional coordination meetings; keep decisions documented and actions closed

· Work closely with engineering leads across disciplines to track technical progress and translate it into clear programme status

· Coordinate system integration activities – ensuring interfaces between subsystems (propulsion, structures, avionics, GSE) are managed, dependencies tracked, and integration milestones owned

· Manage external dependencies: supplier lead times, test facility scheduling, regulatory submissions, and customer milestones

· Proactively flag scope creep, resource conflicts, and schedule risk to leadership – with options, not just problems

· Contribute to building the PM structure, tools, and ways of working for the department alongside team leads and fellow TPMs

Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, systems, or a related engineering discipline

· 5–8 years in a hardware-heavy development environment; at least 2 in a project management, programme coordination, or technical lead role – career PMs without hardware exposure will not be considered

· Background in aerospace, defence, or a similarly regulated hardware domain; familiarity with vehicle-level or system-level development and qualification cycles is essential

· Experience managing cross-disciplinary programmes spanning multiple engineering domains (structures, propulsion, avionics, or similar) is a strong advantage

· Able to manage multiple concurrent projects across engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and testing

· Strong systems thinking – able to see the full picture, spot where the hard problems are likely to sit, and know when to dive into detail without losing the overall programme

· Strong planning skills – able to build a programme schedule from scratch, identify critical path, and keep it current

· Comfortable building structure in an ambiguous environment; pragmatic over bureaucratic

· Clear, direct communicator in English; German is an advantage

title: Director, Clinician Engagement
description:
Position Summary
Clinician Engagement is a new function at DataSpring, created to deepen the relationship between DataSpring and the clinicians and provider organizations who contribute to and rely on our data. The function exists to increase trust and positive perception within the clinician user community, improve the quality of the data clinicians provide, and grow the volume of clinicians in our database, including the number who are active and attested.

The Director, Clinician Engagement leads this function. The position builds and stewards the forums where clinicians and provider staff shape our direction, develops partnerships with the provider organizations clinicians already trust, and serves as DataSpring's internal subject matter expert on clinician perspective. The role accelerates the reach and credibility of work already underway across Marketing, Product, and Insights by bringing clinician voice and clinician relationships to it.

This is role spans strategy and execution. The Director sets direction and holds the senior relationships, and also does the hands-on work of running councils, managing partner relationships week to week, and synthesizing what clinicians say into direction the rest of the organization can act on. Success depends on convening the right clinicians, earning their sustained participation, and closing the loop so they see their input reflected in what DataSpring builds and says.

The Director, Clinician Engagement is a full-time, remote, exempt position and reports to the Chief Medical Officer. This position will require the ability to travel up to 20% of the time for council meetings, site visits, association events, and industry forums.

Specific Responsibilities

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Input

  • Partner with Marketing and Product Strategy on a shared approach to increasing clinician awareness of and engagement with their clinician profile; in partnership with the CMO, drive strategy and execution on how best to reach specific associations, specialty societies, and clinician segments.
  • Partner with Convening function to provide subject matter expertise and input to agendas and meetings for DataSpring’s advisory councils, including the Provider Advisory Council and new clinician staff workgroup. Support the recruitment of council members who bring specialty society and partner organization relationships alongside clinical credibility.
  • Partner with Marketing to amplify campaigns through clinician and association channels and to strengthen clinician-facing messaging.
  • Partner with Product and Data Quality teams to bring clinician and provider staff needs into design and roadmap decisions.
  • Partner with Product, Product Marketing, and Research to understand what additional value DataSpring can provide to clinicians and their staff, in exchange for completing/updating their profiles.
  • Partner with Government & Public Affairs to amplify clinician voice and perspective in DataSpring’s public policy positions, provide clinical subject matter expertise in support of legislative and regulatory analysis, and enhance government and public affairs reach to targeted clinician communities.

Provider Organization Partnerships and Industry Relations

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive clinician engagement strategy to achieve organizational goals and objectives.
  • Build and manage relationships with professional associations, specialty societies, state and national medical associations, health systems, and large group practices.
  • Develop and deliver content that supports the clinician awareness work referenced above, including webinars, podcasts, conference presentations, and partner-facing materials. May include development of continuing education content for clinicians and provider staff, coordinating with partners to deploy.
  • In addition to the CMO, serve as the relationship owner for provider organization partners, representing DataSpring credibly with clinical leadership.
  • Develop and execute co-branded and partner-led approaches that extend the reach of DataSpring programs and campaigns through trusted third-party voices.
  • Coordinate partner campaigns with Marketing from planning through measurement and prepare briefing materials and follow-ups for senior partner conversations.
  • Build and maintain a partnership pipeline with clear prioritization logic, sequencing clinician segments by value to our health plan customers.
  • Negotiate and manage partnership agreements in coordination with Legal, Marketing, Business Development, Product, and other functions as appropriate.

Subject Matter Expertise for Research, Insights, and Thought Leadership

  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert on clinician and practice staff perspective, workflow reality, and what motivates clinician and clinician staff action.
  • Advise DataSpring’s Insights department on research design and interpretation so studies ask the right questions and findings are read correctly in clinician-facing/provider organization context.
  • Support research execution by recruiting participants and reviewing findings for plausibility.
  • Maintain a running view of clinician and provider staff feedback themes across forums, campaigns, and support channels, and package into concise briefs for internal partners.
  • Shape messaging and positioning toward themes that resonate with clinicians, including patient access, directory presence, referral volume, and fewer claim denials.
  • Contribute to and review external thought leadership, including reports, issue briefs, and presentations, and represent DataSpring at clinical, association, and industry forums.

Reporting

  • Define what success looks like and track key performance metrics and clinician engagement metrics covering trust and perception, data quality, and active attested clinician volume. Collaborate with departments that may source data for the metrics (Marketing, Product, etc.).
  • Report on clinician engagement progress and outcomes to the executive leadership team.

Supervisory Responsibilities

None initially. This role is expected to help shape and scale the Clinician Engagement function and may assume responsibility for managing a small team as the function matures

Skills

  • Strategic thinker with the ability to develop and execute innovative initiatives.
  • Strong relationship-building skills with provider organizations, specialty societies, and medical associations.
  • Fluency in the clinician and provider staff experience, including credentialing, attestation, provider directory data, and administrative workflow.
  • Ability to translate qualitative stakeholder input into clear, prioritized recommendations for product, marketing, and research teams.
  • Executive presence and credibility with both clinical leadership and internal executive audiences.
  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to synthesize complex discussion into briefs, PowerPoint presentations, and recommendations.
  • Ability to develop and deliver clinician-facing and clinician-staff facing content, including webinars, presentations, and continuing education materials.
  • Effective at influencing without authority and at building cross-functional support for new initiatives.
  • Strong project management discipline, with comfort operating without established process and building programs from the ground up.
  • Understanding of how clinician sentiment connects to organizational priorities, with the ability to anticipate how input will be used in decisions.
  • Ability to simultaneously manage multiple initiatives and follow work plans.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong experience in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel; working knowledge of CRM and survey tools is desired.
  • Maintains an intellectual curiosity about how to accomplish goals through stakeholder and industry collaboration.

Experience & Education

  • 10+ years of experience in provider relations, clinician engagement, healthcare operations, medical affairs, professional association management, credentialing, or a related healthcare field, with progressive leadership responsibility.
  • Demonstrated experience in provider-facing, clinician engagement, medical affairs, association relations, provider network, or healthcare stakeholder management roles.
  • Proven ability to build and sustain relationships with senior clinical stakeholders, provider organizations, and healthcare industry leaders.
  • Experience leading advisory boards, councils, committees, user groups, or similar stakeholder engagement programs.
  • Experience standing up a new function, program, committee, or stakeholder forum strongly preferred.
  • Experience in a health plan, health IT, healthcare data, healthcare services, credentialing, or healthcare association environment preferred.
  • Experience with provider credentialing processes and/or credentialing committees preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business administration, public health, a clinical discipline, or a related field required.
  • Physicians and other licensed clinicians are encouraged to apply; non-clinical candidates with significant experience in credentialing, provider relations, professional associations, or healthcare stakeholder engagement will also be considered.

Clinical Education & Qualifications (Strongly Preferred)

  • Medical Doctor (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree preferred.
  • Clinical experience as a physician (MD/DO) or other licensed healthcare professional preferred.
  • Active or previously active, unrestricted clinical licensure preferred.
  • Experience participating in credentialing, peer review, provider governance, medical staff, or quality-related activities preferred.
  • For physician candidates, board certification in a relevant specialty is preferred.
  • Additional certification or education in healthcare management, leadership, or business administration is desirable.

Who We Are

DataSpring is the trusted data connector at the core of healthcare. For more than 25 years, we have powered the industry with the largest and most complete healthcare data foundation in the U.S., including more than 4.8 million provider data records sourced directly from providers and member data representing 75% of covered lives supplied by health plans. By improving how essential information flows across the system, DataSpring helps healthcare operate more efficiently, accurately, and with greater confidence.

What You Get

At DataSpring, you will do meaningful work at the intersection of healthcare, data, and technology, helping solve complex problems that make the healthcare system work better. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about accuracy, trust, and meaningful impact in a fully remote environment.

DataSpring offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company contributions and matching, paid parental leave, tuition assistance, and generous paid time off. We are committed to investing in our people and supporting professional growth over time.

Equal Opportunity Employer

DataSpring is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued, respected, and empowered.

Employment decisions at DataSpring are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin or ancestry, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, familial status, family responsibilities, matriculation, political affiliation, genetic information, source of income, place of residence, or any other characteristic protected by law. DataSpring does not tolerate unlawful discrimination or harassment of any kind.

Applicants have rights under the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA),Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO), and the Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA). If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply for a posted position, please contact the DataSpring People & Culture team at or 202-517-0436.

title: Client Service Monitor
description:
Hope Mission Statement

The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

Position Purpose and Summary

The Client Services Monitor (CSM) works directly on-site and is responsible for keeping participants safe, supporting daily operations, community standards and helping Hope the Mission's Interim Housing programs run smoothly. The CSM plays an important role in creating an environment that is safe, structured, and respectful — one where every participant is treated with dignity and fairness.

This position requires someone who shows up consistently, uses good judgment, and genuinely cares about serving people experiencing homelessness. Many participants in our programs have been through long periods of instability, crisis, and trauma. When a CSM shows up with calm, care, and compassion, it creates a sense of safety and routine that participants can count on as they work toward stable housing.

The CSM reports to the Program Manager or Assistant Program Manager and works alongside site staff to make sure the program runs well, meets contract requirements, and reflects Hope the Mission's values in every interaction.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Facility Maintenance and Sanitation

  • Assists with and facilitates routine cleaning of all facility areas to maintain cleanliness, safety, and operational readiness

  • Cleans and disinfects restrooms and shower areas after each use, without exception. Maintains sanitary and safe restroom and sink conditions at all times. Completes deep cleaning of restrooms and common areas.

  • Monitors and maintains hygiene areas and community areas; ensures resources are fully stocked, replenishing as needed.

  • Washes, dries, and prepares towels used for restroom and shower services

  • Monitors laundry rooms, restrooms, and common areas to ensure cleanliness and appropriate use

  • Maintains accurate shower and restroom usage logs

Participant Safety and Monitoring

  • Conducts required wellness checks each shift to ensure participant safety and well-being

  • Monitors participant movement, common areas, and site activity to promote safety and program compliance

  • Conducts routine site walk-throughs and safety checks during assigned shifts

  • Supports contraband control and safety procedures in accordance with agency policy

  • Responds to incidents and emergencies using trauma-informed de-escalation techniques and follows all incident reporting protocols

  • Supports emergency responses — including medical emergencies, overdoses, and evacuations — until leadership or first responders arrive

Participant Services and Engagement

  • Provides direct, respectful assistance to participants, including answering questions, responding to requests, and connecting participants to appropriate staff or resources

  • Assists with participant intake, orientation, and explanation of site guidelines as directed by management

  • Distributes hygiene supplies including soap, shampoo, towels, and related items to participants as needed

  • Supports meal service, supply distribution, and general operational duties as assigned

Documentation and Reporting

  • Completes Daily Activity Reports (DARs) accurately, objectively, and in a timely manner

  • Conducts intake, exit, and case notes in HMIS where applicable

  • Assists with documentation related to participant movements, wellness concerns, or incidents as required

  • Observes and reports safety concerns, maintenance issues, guideline violations, and unusual occurrences to site leadership promptly

Shift Operations

  • Provides support during shift pass-downs and communicates relevant updates between shifts

  • Provides overnight, evening, weekend, or holiday coverage as scheduled

  • Performs other duties as assigned

Transportation (Site Specific)

  • Transports participants to and from established routes and as directed by a supervisor

  • Maintains vehicle cleanliness inside and out at all times

  • Ensures the vehicle has sufficient fuel before and during each shift

  • Completes daily vehicle maintenance checks and reports any issues to the supervisors

  • Logs all mileage accurately and in accordance with departmental procedures

Skills

  • Strong observation and situational awareness skills

  • Trauma-informed communication and de-escalation techniques

  • Ability to maintain professional boundaries with participants

  • Clear, objective, and professional written documentation skills

  • Ability to follow policies, procedures, and chain of command

  • Strong teamwork and communication skills

  • Basic computer and email proficiency

  • Ability to lead with integrity and uphold organizational mission, values, and service philosophy.

  • Ability to cultivate and maintain collaborative relationships with community-based organizations and external service providers. Strong Interpersonal Skills.

  • Maintains professionalism, empathy, and sound decision-making when working in complex or emotionally challenging environments.


Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required

  • Previous experience in homeless services, shelter operations or social service preferred

  • Knowledge of trauma-informed care and harm reduction principles preferred

  • Ability to work flexible schedules including nights, weekends, and holidays


Mandatory Requirements

  • Background Screening – Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of background checks as required per worksite.

  • Drug and Alcohol Testing – Candidates must pass pre-employment and ongoing drug and alcohol screenings in accordance with company policy.

  • Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) Check – For roles requiring driving, employment is contingent upon an acceptable driving record.

  • Legal Eligibility to Work – Candidates must provide proof of legal authorization to work in the US.

  • Compliance with Company Policies and HIPAA standards – All employees must comply with company policies, including safety, confidentiality, and conduct standards.


Physical, Demands, Environmental Conditions, Equipment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions. The employee is required to: walk and climb stairs; stand, bend, squat, climb, kneel, and twist on an intermittent or sometimes continuous basis; grasp, push, pull objects such as files, file cabinet drawers, and reach overhead; handle, finger, grasp and feel objects and equipment; reach with hands and arms; be mobile by moving oneself from place to place quickly and easily; repeat various motions with the wrists, hands, and fingers; be able to perform visual activities for (including, but not limited to) administrative and clerical tasks; ability to lift up to 25 lbs.; communicate, receive and exchange ideas, information by means of the spoken and written word; drive vehicles in and around Los Angeles County; be able to enter various buildings that may require climbing stairs; be periodically subjected to outside environmental conditions. The employee may work in proximity to service animals and emotional support animals; use a desktop and/or laptop computer; various office machines. Complete all required forms in personal writing.

description:
This is a remote position.

Job Title: Data Governance and Management Specialist (Microsoft Purview)

Work Arrangement: Remote

Note: Three professional references from previous employment are required with the application. Each reference must include the organization name, reference's name, phone number, and email address. Resumes submitted without three professional references will not be reviewed.


Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring for the role of Data Governance and Management Specialist on behalf of its client, a state government agency, to support a Medicaid modernization initiative. The specialist will define and document how Medicaid data is governed, cataloged, traced, and managed across State systems, using Microsoft Purview as the primary platform. The role works onsite alongside State Medicaid staff and State IT resources to build a Medicaid data catalog, document data lineage, and produce a Data Governance and Management Plan with practical recommendations for tools and process improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather requirements with State IT resources and agency staff to identify Medicaid data sources, current data mapping, and existing interface structures. Mainframe data is accessed only through State IT resources.
  • Build and maintain a Medicaid data catalog in Microsoft Purview, including business glossary terms, data classifications, metadata, and data owner and steward assignments.
  • Document end-to-end data lineage showing how Medicaid data moves between systems, how it is reported to internal and external partners, and how it is stored, organized, and secured.
  • Develop the Medicaid Data Governance and Management Plan in consultation with agency and State stakeholders, covering policies, roles, standards, data quality, security, and compliance.
  • Assess current data governance and management practices and recommend improvements in data governance, data cataloging, data sharing, and system integration.
  • Identify risks related to current data management, including data inconsistencies, integration challenges, and security or compliance gaps.
  • Recommend tools to support data governance, data cataloging, and data lineage.
  • Prepare a monthly status report on work completed and timelines.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.


Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Expert level knowledge of Microsoft Purview, including Data Catalog, Data Map, lineage, classification, and business glossary.
  • Minimum senior level healthcare services knowledge, expert level preferred. Medicaid or MMIS experience is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing data governance programs and applying governance frameworks and best practices such as DAMA-DMBOK, COBIT, or TOGAF.
  • Proficiency with relational SQL and NoSQL database technologies.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise database management and design best practices.
  • Understanding of business intelligence concepts.
  • Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work onsite in Sioux Falls, South Dakota for the duration of the engagement.

How to Apply

Send an updated resume and three professional references (name, title, organization, phone number, and email address) to talent@dhakatech.us. Please include the job title in the subject line and confirm your availability for a start on or about November 9, 2026 and for onsite work in Sioux Falls, South Dakota.
