title: Client Service Monitor - PT
description:
Hope Mission Statement

The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

Position Purpose and Summary

The Client Services Monitor (CSM) works directly on-site and is responsible for keeping participants safe, supporting daily operations, community standards and helping Hope the Mission's Interim Housing programs run smoothly. The CSM plays an important role in creating an environment that is safe, structured, and respectful — one where every participant is treated with dignity and fairness.

This position requires someone who shows up consistently, uses good judgment, and genuinely cares about serving people experiencing homelessness. Many participants in our programs have been through long periods of instability, crisis, and trauma. When a CSM shows up with calm, care, and compassion, it creates a sense of safety and routine that participants can count on as they work toward stable housing.

The CSM reports to the Program Manager or Assistant Program Manager and works alongside site staff to make sure the program runs well, meets contract requirements, and reflects Hope the Mission's values in every interaction.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Facility Maintenance and Sanitation

  • Assists with and facilitates routine cleaning of all facility areas to maintain cleanliness, safety, and operational readiness

  • Cleans and disinfects restrooms and shower areas after each use, without exception. Maintains sanitary and safe restroom and sink conditions at all times. Completes deep cleaning of restrooms and common areas.

  • Monitors and maintains hygiene areas and community areas; ensures resources are fully stocked, replenishing as needed.

  • Washes, dries, and prepares towels used for restroom and shower services

  • Monitors laundry rooms, restrooms, and common areas to ensure cleanliness and appropriate use

  • Maintains accurate shower and restroom usage logs

Participant Safety and Monitoring

  • Conducts required wellness checks each shift to ensure participant safety and well-being

  • Monitors participant movement, common areas, and site activity to promote safety and program compliance

  • Conducts routine site walk-throughs and safety checks during assigned shifts

  • Supports contraband control and safety procedures in accordance with agency policy

  • Responds to incidents and emergencies using trauma-informed de-escalation techniques and follows all incident reporting protocols

  • Supports emergency responses — including medical emergencies, overdoses, and evacuations — until leadership or first responders arrive

Participant Services and Engagement

  • Provides direct, respectful assistance to participants, including answering questions, responding to requests, and connecting participants to appropriate staff or resources

  • Assists with participant intake, orientation, and explanation of site guidelines as directed by management

  • Distributes hygiene supplies including soap, shampoo, towels, and related items to participants as needed

  • Supports meal service, supply distribution, and general operational duties as assigned

Documentation and Reporting

  • Completes Daily Activity Reports (DARs) accurately, objectively, and in a timely manner

  • Conducts intake, exit, and case notes in HMIS where applicable

  • Assists with documentation related to participant movements, wellness concerns, or incidents as required

  • Observes and reports safety concerns, maintenance issues, guideline violations, and unusual occurrences to site leadership promptly

Shift Operations

  • Provides support during shift pass-downs and communicates relevant updates between shifts

  • Provides overnight, evening, weekend, or holiday coverage as scheduled

  • Performs other duties as assigned

Transportation (Site Specific)

  • Transports participants to and from established routes and as directed by a supervisor

  • Maintains vehicle cleanliness inside and out at all times

  • Ensures the vehicle has sufficient fuel before and during each shift

  • Completes daily vehicle maintenance checks and reports any issues to the supervisors

  • Logs all mileage accurately and in accordance with departmental procedures

Skills

  • Strong observation and situational awareness skills

  • Trauma-informed communication and de-escalation techniques

  • Ability to maintain professional boundaries with participants

  • Clear, objective, and professional written documentation skills

  • Ability to follow policies, procedures, and chain of command

  • Strong teamwork and communication skills

  • Basic computer and email proficiency

  • Ability to lead with integrity and uphold organizational mission, values, and service philosophy.

  • Ability to cultivate and maintain collaborative relationships with community-based organizations and external service providers. Strong Interpersonal Skills.

  • Maintains professionalism, empathy, and sound decision-making when working in complex or emotionally challenging environments.


Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required

  • Previous experience in homeless services, shelter operations or social service preferred

  • Knowledge of trauma-informed care and harm reduction principles preferred

  • Ability to work flexible schedules including nights, weekends, and holidays


Mandatory Requirements

  • Background Screening – Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of background checks as required per worksite.

  • Drug and Alcohol Testing – Candidates must pass pre-employment and ongoing drug and alcohol screenings in accordance with company policy.

  • Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) Check – For roles requiring driving, employment is contingent upon an acceptable driving record.

  • Legal Eligibility to Work – Candidates must provide proof of legal authorization to work in the US.

  • Compliance with Company Policies and HIPAA standards – All employees must comply with company policies, including safety, confidentiality, and conduct standards.


Physical, Demands, Environmental Conditions, Equipment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions. The employee is required to: walk and climb stairs; stand, bend, squat, climb, kneel, and twist on an intermittent or sometimes continuous basis; grasp, push, pull objects such as files, file cabinet drawers, and reach overhead; handle, finger, grasp and feel objects and equipment; reach with hands and arms; be mobile by moving oneself from place to place quickly and easily; repeat various motions with the wrists, hands, and fingers; be able to perform visual activities for (including, but not limited to) administrative and clerical tasks; ability to lift up to 25 lbs.; communicate, receive and exchange ideas, information by means of the spoken and written word; drive vehicles in and around Los Angeles County; be able to enter various buildings that may require climbing stairs; be periodically subjected to outside environmental conditions. The employee may work in proximity to service animals and emotional support animals; use a desktop and/or laptop computer; various office machines. Complete all required forms in personal writing.


Work Environment

The employee may be in contact with individuals and families in crisis who may be ill, using alcohol and drugs, and who may not be attentive to basic personal hygiene, health and safety practices. The employee may experience a number of unpleasant sensory demands associated with the participants’ use of alcohol and drugs, and lack of personal hygiene. The employee must be ready to respond quickly and effectively to many types of situations, including crisis situations and potentially hostile situations. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate in an office setting. Sometimes work may become stressful when working under pressure or in crisis intervention. .

title: Senior full stack developer – .net / azure / iot – join global iot tech company building cloud-based monitoring solutions for critical infrastructure – cape town, r1.4m – r1.8m
description:
This is an excellent opportunity for a SENIOR FULL STACK DEVELOPER –. NET / Azure / Io T – to join a global Io T tech company transforming how critical infrastructure is monitored and managed.

Based in CAPE TOWN (Hybrid) this SENIOR FULL STACK DEVELOPER role (. NET / Azure / Io T) offers a salary of R1.4m – R1.8m.

THE COMPANY:

This is a fast-growing international tech company building industrial Io T and remote-monitoring solutions for critical infrastructure. Their technology connects intelligent devices operating in demanding real-world environments with a sophisticated cloud platform, enabling organisations to monitor and manage assets across water, wastewater, rail, mining and industrial operations.

Think software + cloud + data + Io T + physical devices.

For a Senior Developer, they offer the opportunity to work at the intersection of software, cloud, data and Io T, solving complex engineering problems where the technology you build has a genuine, measurable impact in the physical world.

THE ROLE:

This is a hands-on, predominantly backend engineering role where you'll take ownership of major features and services across the full development lifecycle - from architecture and design through development, deployment and long-term production operation.

You'll build scalable backend services and APIs, shape domain logic, design integrations and work across the boundaries between cloud software, frontend applications and physical Io T devices.

You'll work closely with embedded engineers as new devices are introduced to the platform, designing software that accounts for how those devices actually behave once they're deployed in the real world.

You'll also have genuine architectural influence.

You'll be expected to challenge designs, make sensible engineering trade-offs and help determine how the platform evolves - balancing performance, security, reliability, scalability, cost and speed of delivery.

THE CORE ENGINEERING ENVIRONMENT INCLUDES:

You'll also encounter architectural and distributed-system concepts including DDD, CQRS, event-driven architecture, event sourcing, idempotency, retries, eventual consistency, multi-tenancy, high availability and fault tolerance.

The Azure ecosystem includes technologies such as Io T Hub, Event Hubs, Signal R, Key Vault and Redis.

WHY IS THIS INTERESTING?

Because the software actually does something in the physical world.

The API you design, service you optimise or architecture decision you make doesn't simply disappear into another corporate application.

It's part of a technology platform connecting real devices, collecting real-world information and helping organisations manage important physical infrastructure.

You'll also be joining an international engineering organisation where senior developers are expected to think, challenge, design, mentor and own - not simply work their way through a backlog.

REQUIRED SKILLS: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering. 7+ years of full-time software development experience, including building and operating cloud environments in production. Solid proficiency in backend and some frontend development, using C#/. NET, ASP. NET Core (Web APIs), RESTful APIs, and Type Script. Deep understanding of software engineering foundations, including data structures, algorithms, software design principles, version control, and collaborative development workflows. Proficiency with SQL (including SQL Server query tuning and indexing) and/or No SQL datastores. Preferably with experience using Entity Framework Core. Experience designing and operating modular monolith and/or microservices-based cloud-native architectures, with understanding of CQRS, Dependency Injection, Fluent Validation, JSON serialization, and the Task Parallel Library (TPL). Extensive experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure. Strong understanding of Saa S and Paa S architectures, including multi-tenancy, high availability, and scaling patterns. Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (preferably Bicep), CI/CD pipelines (preferably Azure), and automated testing. Working knowledge of cloud networking concepts, including hub-and-spoke networking, VPNs, SD-WAN, and firewalls. Proven end-to-end ownership of systems across the full lifecycle, from architecture and design through long-term production operation. Strong architectural and operational judgment, balancing delivery speed with reliability, security, performance, and long-term maintainability. Proven ability to debug complex production issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement durable fixes that reduce operational risk. Experience leading significant architectural initiatives or cross-team technical efforts and influencing technical direction. Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, raise code and design quality, and lead effective design and code reviews. Experience using AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate delivery and improve solution quality. Practical experience with advanced architectural patterns such as event-driven architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), event sourcing, and distributed systems patterns (e.g. idempotency, retries, eventual consistency). Deep understanding of resilience, fault tolerance, security requirements, and complex performance trade-offs in multi-tenant Saa S platforms. Advanced performance tuning skills, including SQL query plan analysis and low-level optimisations (e.g. Value Task, threading, and synchronization). Experience with API lifecycle management and relevant services (Azure preferred) such as Io T Hub, Event Hubs, Signal R, Key Vault, and Redis.

title: Associate Designer
description:
Hybrid’s humble beginnings started in 1997 in the back of a print shop designing, selling, and printing tee shirts. Today, Hybrid is a global apparel industry powerhouse in brand and licensing management. Hybrid provides its expertise and fully vertical operations capability – design, merchandising, development, sourcing, production, and distribution – to a broad suite of branded, licensed, generic, and private label partners. Hybrid’s full-service apparel design and manufacturing expertise extends across the apparel category, including knits, woven tops, bottoms, tees, and accessories.


As our organization has evolved, so has our philosophy of doing business. We have made concerted efforts to remove ourselves from the antiquated approach of other apparel manufacturers and doing things differently has been our focus. We are building a company ethos that breeds innovation, collaboration, integrity and excellence in customer service.

What is my role?

The Associate Designer, in partnership with the cross-functional team (Pre-production, Production, Graphics, etc.) assists the Designer and Director directly to execute product. They research relevant trends, communicate with the cross-functional team and provide support to the Designer

What You'll Do

  • Research and identify trends that are relevant to our customers, bring ideas and inspiration
  • Develop strong working relationships with the teams through communications and problem solving
  • Create presentation linesheets from start to finish
  • Work with designer and director to create seasonal direction in silhouette, fabric and concept for specific retailers/market
  • Execute and help in presentation books/art CAD’s
  • Attend and participate in fit sessions with designer
  • Communicate and execute technical information through PLM to the Technical Designer
  • Understand the fundamentals of the production process as it relates to their classification
  • Manage deadlines in accordance with the calendar
  • Assist in coding art and revisions of CAD’s
  • Assist in sample execution
  • Maintain organized filing system for all CAD’s on server
  • Help maintain the day-to-day projects including filing/organizing, tagging, line preparation, copying and updating development, packages, fabric books, shipping/tracking packages

What You’ll Need

  • 2 or 4 year college degree in Fashion Design, Merchandising, Textiles, Fine Art, or related field
  • Portfolio required
  • 2-3 years previous experience designing apparel
  • Previous experience designing juniors apparel a plus
  • Strong sense of color, style, and trend
  • Extremely proficient in the Adobe Creative suite
  • Attention to detail and follow-up skills
  • Garment construction & fabric knowledge
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines
  • Enjoys working in a fast-paced environment

Hybrid Apparel is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Seasonal Biologist, Sea Turtle Rehabilitation
description:
Position Summary

This is a full time seasonal position lasting 3 months.

The Sea Turtle Rehabilitation Center Seasonal Biologist supports the care and rehabilitation of rescued marine turtles and contributes to daily facility operations at the Sea Turtle Rehabilitation Center (STRC), located at The Florida Aquarium’s Apollo Beach campus. This role also involves field response and animal transport activities in support of the Sea Turtle Stranding and Salvage Network (STSSN). The position will ensure all activities are conducted in compliance with Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC) regulations and guidelines, in coordination with the Animal Health team

Essential Position Functions

• Ensure full compliance with all Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC) marine turtle regulations, as well as adherence to The Florida Aquarium’s (TFA) established processes, protocols, and standard operating procedures (SOPs), including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE).

• Perform daily husbandry responsibilities for marine turtles, including but not limited to diet preparation, feeding, and assisting with medical procedures such as diagnostics and treatments.

• Maintain the highest standards of care for marine turtle habitats and life support systems (LSS), including tasks such as diving to clean enclosures, maintaining and monitoring ozone and LSS equipment, conducting water quality testing, and performing water changes in accordance with SOPs.

• Support field operations including the response, rescue, and transportation of stranded marine turtles; assist with data and sample collection, necropsy procedures both onsite and in the field, carcass disposal, and the release of rehabilitated turtles.

• Ensures accurate animal record keeping through consistent utilization of electronic record keeping system (Tracks).

• Supports TFA’s Shared Purpose by participating in a Conservation Day of Action shift on an annual basis.

• Performs other duties as assigned.


Education, Requirements, and Technical Skills

• Bachelor’s degree in biological sciences or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

• Minimum of one year of direct experience working with marine turtles, with foundational knowledge of husbandry practices and environmental parameters necessary for their care.

• Working knowledge of life support system (LSS) operations and troubleshooting, including chlorine and ozone disinfection systems, as well as water quality testing and chemical management.

• Strong knowledge of Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC) and Sea Turtle Stranding and Salvage Network (STSSN) protocols and procedures preferred

• Schedule flexibility during cold-stun season

• Ability to work on-call as a part of a rotating roster to respond to emergencies or stranding events as needed

• SCUBA certification is required

• Knowledge of animal record-keeping systems (ZIMS/Tracks) preferred

Ensures that customer satisfaction is a priority in all areas of responsibility. Actively engages our customers while fulfilling job responsibilities.

title: Project Coordinator - Operations
description:
The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

Position Purpose and Summary

Every repair, vendor visit, permit renewal, and vehicle inspection at HTM begins as a request that someone has to receive, route, and follow through on until it is closed. The Operations Coordinator is that person.

Reporting to the Director of Operations, the Project Coordinator - Operations serves as the intake, dispatch, and coordination point for the Operations Department across Facilities and Maintenance, Safety, IT, Fleet Management, and Warehouse and Delivery Logistics. This role monitors and triages the MaintainX queue and assigns work to the appropriate staff member or approved vendor; maintains the departmental compliance calendar for licenses, permits, inspections, and fleet records; solicits quotes and issues purchase requests within assigned thresholds; reconciles vendor invoices; and compiles the reporting that department and senior leadership rely on. The Operations Coordinator supports both the Director of Operations and the Operations Manager.

Operations is a department where the cost of a dropped request is measured in a shelter without hot water or a van that cannot make a food run. The Operations Coordinator exists so that requests are not dropped, deadlines are not missed, and no repair, renewal, or inspection depends on someone remembering it. This is not clerical work performed in service of a department. It is the mechanism by which the department keeps its commitments.

Responsibilities

Request Intake and Dispatch

● Monitor the MaintainX queue and all Operations request channels throughout the workday. Log, categorize, and assign priority to every incoming request.

● Dispatch requests to the appropriate Facilities, Maintenance, Safety, IT, or Fleet staff member, or to an approved vendor, based on trade, site location, and urgency.

● Acknowledge every incoming request within the departmental 24-hour response standard. Confirm receipt to the requesting site and communicate an estimated response time.

● Redistribute open work when a staff member is unavailable or a site escalates. Notify the Director of Operations or Operations Leadership of any request that cannot be assigned within standard.

● Track open tickets through to closure. Follow up on aging work orders and escalate any request that exceeds the established resolution window.

● Recognize matters that require management judgment rather than routine routing, and escalate them promptly rather than resolving them independently.

Vendor and Purchasing Coordination

title: Revenue Strategy & Planning Lead
description:
About Thunes

Thunes is the Smart Superhighway for money movement around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real-time in over 130 countries and more than 80 currencies. Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 7 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, via more than 350 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.

Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 12 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Riyadh, San Francisco, Sao Paulo and Shanghai. For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com

Position Overview

We are looking for a Revenue Strategy & Planning Lead who sits at the intersection of rigorous analysis and relentless execution. In this role, you will partner directly with our senior leaders (CRO, CFO, COO) to help shape our global growth plans—and then roll up your sleeves to drive those cross-functional projects across the finish line. We don't just want a thinker who builds plans in a silo; we need a doer who can manage complex strategic initiatives from the whiteboarding phase to full deployment.

This is an opportunity to help build the growth engine behind one of the world's most ambitious cross-border payments platforms. If you view ambiguity as an invitation to build, excel at project management, and know how to turn complex data into an actionable roadmap, this is the role for you.

What you’ll own

  • Strategic projects: Driving critical cross-functional revenue initiatives to completion. You will act as the execution engine for all our major GTM projects
  • Competitive intelligence: Owning deep research into competitive landscapes and customer segments to inform our strategic direction and sales motions.
  • The growth plan: Coordinating our major planning cycles, while arming our sales leaders with the rigorous insights they need to set strategy and targets.
  • Sales operational excellence: Fixing what's broken and optimizing what works. You own the tactical projects that strip inefficiency out of the sales process and give our reps more time to sell.

Who you are

  • You know that “let’s just launch it” actually involves 47 distinct steps. You take massive, ambiguous goals, map the entire journey, and get a room full of strong opinions executing on a single plan.
  • You know a spreadsheet isn't a strategy. You take dense, complex data points and translate them into the real-world operational changes our sales leaders actually care about.
  • You are allergic to the phrase "that's not my job." When a critical growth initiative stalls between functions, you are the one who jumps in and pushes it across the finish line.
  • You care about AI as a tool, not a buzzword. You are constantly scouting for practical ways to plug AI into our daily workflows to eliminate manual grunt work and make the revenue org ruthlessly efficient.

What you bring

  • 5-8+ years of high-growth B2B experience: You’ve cut your teeth in Sales Strategy & Ops, Consulting, BizOps, Strategic Finance, or Chief of Staff roles.
  • Scars from actual execution: You don't just build strategy decks; you have a proven track record of successfully rolling them out across complex global SaaS, fintech, or platform businesses.

Customers map boundaries, plan stripes, and set full mowing routes with QuickPlan software inside our FireLink platform. They place the mower in the field and start the plan from FireLink. title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:
Location: Rochester, New York

Department: Information Technology

Reports to: Director of Information Technology

Work arrangement: On-site or Remote

Travel: Occasional travel, approximately 25%, for site visits, user training, and partner engagements.

Compensation: The target hiring range is generally $115,000–$135,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, education, internal equity, and business needs. This role is eligible for QED's annual performance-based incentive program with a target opportunity of 15% of base salary, as well as a comprehensive benefits package and 401(k) program.

About QED Technologies

At QED Technologies, we are building what's next.

For 30 years, QED has helped customers solve complex challenges in precision optics through advanced fabrication and metrology technologies. Our proprietary solutions support applications across aerospace and defense, semiconductor manufacturing, space and astronomy, research, fusion, and other advanced industries.

Our work depends on talented people who bring curiosity, precision, collaboration, and ownership to difficult problems. We are building a high-performing culture where people are trusted to make an impact, teams work across boundaries, and continuous improvement is part of how we operate.

The Opportunity

The Senior Business Systems Analyst owns the functional health and forward roadmap of QED's Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform supporting sales and service, and Business Central (ERP) supporting finance, supply chain, and production.

Reporting to the Director of Information Technology, this senior individual-contributor role is the bridge between business process owners and technology: it translates how QED actually works into system configuration, and applies continuous improvement discipline to confirm a process is worth automating before it gets automated. You will carry meaningful influence over process design, the systems roadmap, and implementation partner selection.

This is more than a system-administration role. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable configuring a business process flow, sitting with Finance during month-end close, and facilitating a cross-functional kaizen event on the shop floor. You will bring both deep platform expertise and the process discipline to know when a system change is the right answer and when it isn't.

What You Will Do

Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CRM)

  • Own functional configuration of Sales and Customer Service - tables, forms, views, business rules, and business process flows.
  • Administer security roles, business units, and field-level security; manage user provisioning and license assignment.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to design and refine the lead-to-opportunity-to-quote process.

Dynamics 365 Business Central (ERP)

  • Own functional configuration across finance, inventory, purchasing, sales order processing, and production modules.
  • Maintain item master, bills of material, routings, costing methods, and dimension structures; safeguard master data quality.
  • Support month-end and year-end close alongside Finance; troubleshoot posting, costing, and reconciliation issues.
  • Manage Business Central release waves by evaluate upcoming features, validate in sandbox, and coordinate cutover with minimal operational disruption.

Continuous improvement

  • Lead process mapping and value stream analysis across order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, and quote-to-delivery workflows.
  • Apply Lean and Six Sigma methods (DMAIC, root cause analysis, standard work, waste elimination) to reduce cycle time and manual handling before configuring a system solution.
  • Define and track process KPIs; publish improvement results and realized benefits to stakeholders.
  • Facilitate kaizen events and requirements workshops with Sales, Finance, Operations, Engineering, and Quality.

Support, training, and governance

  • Serve as the escalation point for Tier 2 and Tier 3 functional issues; manage the VAR/partner relationship and support backlog.
  • Develop end-user training materials, standard operating procedures, and system documentation; deliver onboarding for new users.
  • Chair the systems change-control process - intake, prioritization, testing, and release approval.
  • Support audit and compliance requirements, including segregation of duties, periodic access reviews, and controlled handling of regulated data.
  • Define functional requirements for system integrations and validate integrated data, partnering with the integration owner on design and troubleshooting.

What Success Looks Like

  • QED's Dynamics 365 CRM and ERP platforms remain functionally healthy, well-configured, and aligned with how the business actually operates.
  • Process improvements are grounded in Lean and Six Sigma discipline, with system changes made only after a process has been validated as worth automating.
  • Month-end and year-end close run smoothly, with posting, costing, and reconciliation issues resolved quickly in partnership with Finance.
  • Release waves and system upgrades are evaluated, tested, and deployed with minimal disruption to daily operations.
  • End users receive clear training, documentation, and responsive support, with escalations resolved efficiently through the VAR/partner relationship.
  • The systems change-control process runs with discipline, and audit and compliance requirements are consistently met.
  • Sales, Finance, Operations, Engineering, and Quality view the Senior Business Systems Analyst as a trusted partner who understands both their process and the underlying systems.

What You Bring

  • B.S. in Business, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Seven or more years in business systems analysis, ERP/CRM administration, or functional consulting.
  • Demonstrated functional ownership of both a CRM platform and Business Central.
  • Strong working knowledge of core business processes - order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory management, and standard costing.
  • Proven ability to elicit requirements from non-technical stakeholders and translate them into documented process and system configuration.
  • Experience leading a system implementation, upgrade, or migration end to end.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt, or a documented record of leading continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Microsoft certifications: MB-800 (Business Central Functional Consultant), MB-210 (Sales), MB-230 (Customer Service).
  • Manufacturing experience, particularly in discrete or engineer-to-order production environments.
  • Enough familiarity with AL and extension development concepts to scope, review, and validate partner work.
  • Experience in a regulated or defense supply chain environment (ITAR/EAR, CMMC, AS9100, or ISO 9001).

Work Location

Remote employment possible. Relocation will not be provided for this role.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

QED Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse and inclusive workplace and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

QED Technologies provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs, in accordance with applicable law. If you require an accommodation to complete the application process, please contact Human Resources.

Background Check

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, consistent with applicable law.

Export-Control Notice

This position may involve access to information, technology, software, or products controlled under U.S. export-control laws and regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations and Export Administration Regulations. Where applicable, QED may need to determine whether an export license or other authorization is required for a candidate to access controlled information.

title: Middle Backend Developer (PHP · AWS Lambda · AI)
description:
Bear Claw is an AI-powered recruiting and applicant tracking platform built to help recruiters work smarter and place top talent faster. Our platform brings the entire recruiting workflow into one system — from candidate and job management to team collaboration, sourcing, and outreach. At the center is Cora, our conversational AI assistant, which uses vector search and LLM-powered technology to identify candidate-job matches, surface opportunities, and help recruiters take action faster. Bear Claw combines powerful recruiting technology with practical AI to make the hiring process more efficient, intelligent, and scalable.


About the Role


We're looking for a Middle Backend Developer to join our engineering team and help build and scale the services that power our product. You'll spend most of your time working in PHP on a serverless architecture built with AWS Lambda, backed by MySQL. Alongside our core backend, we're investing heavily in AI-driven features — so you'll also support and extend our AI Agent functionality, which is written in Python and backed by PostgreSQL.

This is a hands-on role for someone who writes clean, reliable, well-tested code, cares about doing things the right way, and is excited to build scalable solutions that make use of AI. You'll have real ownership over the features you ship and room to grow toward more senior technical work.


What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services in PHP running on AWS Lambda (serverless).
  • Model, query, and optimize data in MySQL — including schema design, indexing, and query performance.
  • Support, maintain, and extend our AI Agent functionality written in Python and backed by PostgreSQL.
  • Build scalable solutions that leverage AI/LLM capabilities, turning new AI features from prototype into production-grade services.
  • Write high-quality, maintainable code that follows engineering best practices — clear structure, tests, and sensible patterns.
  • Participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving constructive feedback.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and internal services reliably and securely.
  • Monitor, debug, and optimize the performance, reliability, and cost of serverless functions.
  • Contribute to technical discussions, documentation, and continuous improvement of our codebase and processes.
  • Collaborate closely with product, frontend, and other engineers to deliver features end to end.


What We're Looking For

  • Roughly 2–4 years of professional backend development experience.
  • Strong, practical experience with PHP in a production environment.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Lambda or serverless architecture (and comfort with the AWS ecosystem generally).
  • Solid MySQL skills: relational data modeling, writing efficient queries, and troubleshooting performance.
  • Working knowledge of Python — enough to confidently read, support, and extend the AI agent codebase.
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL.
  • Good understanding of REST APIs, version control (Git), automated testing, and general software best practices.
  • Genuine interest in AI/LLM-based features and a willingness to grow your skills in that area.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently on well-scoped tasks.


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience building or integrating AI agents / LLM-powered features (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks, and prompt/tooling design).
  • Experience with additional AWS services: API Gateway, SQS, S3, AuroraDB, CloudWatch, Lambda, SNS.
  • Familiarity with event-driven / message-queue architectures.
  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation).
  • Exposure to vector databases or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Comfort working across two language stacks (PHP + Python) without friction.


What You'll Bring as a Teammate

  • Ownership — you take responsibility for what you ship, from first commit to production.
  • Clear communication — you explain your thinking and collaborate well with others.
  • A quality mindset — you care about clean, tested, maintainable code, not just \"make it work.\"
  • Curiosity — especially about AI and how to apply it in scalable, practical ways.


Perks:

  • Competitive base salary and comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare, vision, dental, and a 401(k).
  • Work closely with like-minded industry professionals dedicated to innovation and success.
  • Strong company culture of high performance and quality customer care.

Multiple career advancement paths: ability to develop niche skills and move into management

title: Pædagogiske medarbejdere søges til vores Bo-afdelinger på Else Hus i Karlslunde
description:
Har du lyst til at gøre en forskel for mennesker med komplekse behov – og vil du udvikle dig fagligt i et stærkt fællesskab?

På Else Hus søger vi engagerede pædagogiske medarbejdere, der vil være med til at skabe tryghed, trivsel og livskvalitet for mennesker med komplekse autismespektrumforstyrrelser.

Hos os handler det om mere end omsorg. Det handler om at forstå det enkelte menneske, skabe meningsfulde relationer og arbejde målrettet med struktur, forudsigelighed og udvikling. Det kræver faglighed, tålmodighed og evnen til at bevare roen – også når hverdagen udfordrer.

Til gengæld bliver du en del af et specialiseret tilbud, hvor vi prioriterer faglig sparring, supervision og et tæt samarbejde om kerneopgaven.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så læs videre.

Om Else Hus

Else Hus er et regionalt botilbud for 18 borgere med komplekse autismespektrumforstyrrelser og et lavere kognitivt udviklingsniveau. Beboerne bor i tre huse med seks beboere i hvert hus.

Beboerne har behov for omfattende støtte i hverdagen. Det gælder både socialpædagogisk støtte, personlig pleje og hjælp til daglige rutiner og praktiske opgaver.

Vores opgave er at skabe en hverdag med tryghed, genkendelighed og forudsigelighed, hvor den enkelte borger mødes med respekt, og hvor indsatsen tager udgangspunkt i borgerens behov, ressourcer og forudsætninger.

Vi har et internt dagtilbud og lægger stor vægt på et tæt samarbejde mellem dag- og døgntilbuddet, så der skabes sammenhæng i borgernes hverdag.

Du bliver en del af en tværfaglig medarbejdergruppe på cirka 80 medarbejdere bestående af blandt andre pædagoger, social- og sundhedsassistenter og servicemedarbejdere. Vi arbejder sammen på tværs af fagligheder, fordi vi ved, at kvaliteten i indsatsen skabes i fællesskab.

Din hverdag hos os

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor relationsarbejde, pædagogiske indsatser og praktiske opgaver går hånd i hånd.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

● Skabe trygge og tillidsfulde relationer til beboerne.

● Understøtte beboernes trivsel, kommunikation og udvikling gennem en struktureret og individuelt tilpasset pædagogisk indsats.

● Hjælpe med personlig pleje og daglige rutiner, herunder støtte til personlig hygiejne.

● Deltage i aktiviteter og ture i nærområdet, fx gå-, løbe- og cykelture.

● Have pædagogisk og praktisk ansvar for 1–2 beboere i samarbejde med kolleger, faglige konsulenter og pårørende.

● Bidrage aktivt til faglig sparring, personalemøder og tværfagligt samarbejde.

● Deltage i supervision og løbende refleksion over egen og fælles praksis.

● Tage del i de praktiske opgaver, der får hverdagen til at fungere, herunder madlavning, oprydning og rengøring.

Vi forventer, at du tager medansvar for både relationen til den enkelte borger og det fælles arbejde i huset.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger medarbejdere, der møder mennesker med respekt, nysgerrighed og anerkendelse – og som kan se muligheder og ressourcer, også når kommunikationen eller samspillet kræver noget særligt.

Du kan have en pædagogisk eller sundhedsfaglig uddannelse, men du kan også komme i betragtning med relevant erfaring og de rette personlige og faglige kompetencer.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

● Arbejder anerkendende og ressourcefokuseret.

● Er nysgerrig på borgernes perspektiver og behov og kan tilpasse din tilgang til den enkelte.

● Arbejder struktureret og bidrager til en hverdag med tydelighed og forudsigelighed.

● Kan reflektere over egen praksis, modtage feedback og omsætte faglig sparring til handling.

● Trives i et tæt teamsamarbejde og forstår betydningen af fælles aftaler og ensartede tilgange.

● Har personlig robusthed og kan bevare roen og overblikket i situationer, der kræver ekstra tålmodighed og omtanke.

● Har IT-kendskab på brugerniveau.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har kørekort til personbil.

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, tager ansvar for din opgave og vil bidrage aktivt til både borgernes trivsel og kollegernes arbejdsmiljø.

Hvad får du hos os?

På Else Hus står du ikke alene med opgaven. Vi tror på, at god specialpædagogik udvikles gennem samarbejde, refleksion og en fælles faglig retning.

Vi tilbyder dig:

● Et stærkt tværfagligt fællesskab med fokus på kvalitet i den pædagogiske indsats.

● En faglig tilgang med KRAP, Low Arousal, visuel struktur og forudsigelighed.

● Grundig introduktion og onboarding, så du får et godt kendskab til beboerne, opgaverne og vores faglige tilgange.

● Løbende supervision og faglig sparring.

● Mulighed for relevante kurser og faglig udvikling.

● En varieret arbejdsdag, hvor du får mulighed for at gøre en konkret forskel.

● Kollegaer, som du kan dele erfaringer, refleksioner og ansvar med.

Vi ønsker en arbejdsplads, hvor vi er åbne om det, der er svært, lærer af vores erfaringer og sammen finder de bedste løsninger for beboerne.

Arbejdstid og ansættelsesvilkår

● Skiftende arbejdstider i tidsrummet kl. 7.00–23.00 efter et fast arbejdsrul – dog primært aften.

● Arbejde hver anden weekend.

● Cirka 18 fremmødedage om måneden.

● Fast mødeaktivitet om onsdagen kl. 12.00–15.00.

● Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.

Praktisk information

Arbejdssted: Else Hus, Skelbakken 8, 2690 Karlslunde.

Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt.

Ansøgningsfrist: 15. november 2026

Vi afholder samtaler løbende - Der indhentes straffeattest og referencer inden ansættelse.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Lise Gøbel Lorentzen på telefon 3071 6561

Læs mere om Else Hus på www.else-hus.dk.

Har du lyst til at blive en del af vores faglige fællesskab og gøre en forskel i menneskers hverdag? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig!


Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Else Hus

Else Hus er et regionalt dag- og botilbud for voksne mennesker med udviklingshæmning og autisme.

Fælles for beboerne på Else Hus er, at de har behov for hjælp og støtte til alle funktioner, samt en genkendelig og forudsigelig hverdag som er tilrettelagt ud fra den enkeltes ressourcer og behov.

Else Hus ligger i Karlslunde og rummer tre selvstændige bo-enheder med plads til 6 beboere i hvert hus, vores dagtilbud, som benyttes af alle vores beboere, samt to særforanstaltninger beliggende i Lejre.

title: Vice President, Strategic Accounts- Software
description:
About the Role


The Opportunity


We are seeking a Vice President, Strategic Account Sales to build and lead Esko’s global Tier 1 Strategic Account organization. Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, this leader will be responsible for a defined portfolio of existing customers and prospective customers that meet Esko’s strategic-account criteria based on factors such as revenue potential, global complexity, portfolio fit, strategic relevance, and long-term partnership opportunity.


This leader will own the overall commercial performance of the Tier 1 portfolio—including new-customer acquisition, retention, expansion, recurring-revenue growth, profitability, pipeline development, and forecast accuracy. The Vice President will lead a team of Global Strategic Account Managers who serve as the single commercial owners of their assigned accounts, managing the full relationship from strategy and executive alignment through opportunity development and commercial execution.


The mandate is to transform how Esko engages its most important customers and prospects: moving from transactional, product-led selling to consultative, value-based partnerships. This includes establishing rigorous account and pursuit planning, building executive-level relationships, uncovering enterprise-wide opportunities, and developing strategic commercial models such as multiyear agreements and Enterprise License Agreements.


The Vice President will bring together Sales, Customer Success, Presales, Product, Services, Marketing, partners, and Esko’s executive leadership around one coordinated strategy for each account. Success will be measured by sustainable portfolio growth, strong retention and expansion, new strategic customer acquisition, improved commercial discipline, deeper executive relationships, and customers who view Esko as a trusted strategic partner.


What You'll Do


In this role, you will:


  • Build and lead Esko’s global Strategic Account Sales organization, establishing the operating model, performance expectations, and execution standards for the Tier 1 portfolio.
  • Recruit, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Global Strategic Account Managers, with each SAM serving as the single commercial owner of assigned strategic customers and prospects.
  • Own the overall commercial performance of the Tier 1 portfolio, including bookings, recurring-revenue growth, new-customer acquisition, retention, expansion, profitability, pipeline development, and forecast accuracy.
  • Establish clear criteria and governance for identifying and managing strategic customers and high-potential prospects in partnership with Esko’s leadership team.
  • Develop and execute multiyear strategic account plans for existing customers and comprehensive pursuit plans for Tier 1 prospects.
  • Expand Esko’s presence within strategic customers by identifying new buying centers, business units, geographies, use cases, and enterprise-wide opportunities across Esko’s portfolio.
  • Shift customer engagement from transactional product selling to consultative, value-based selling through executive discovery, trusted-advisor workshops, business-value assessments, and outcome-based proposals.
  • Develop and execute strategic commercial models, including Enterprise License Agreements, multiyear agreements, and portfolio-based solutions that increase customer value and strengthen long-term relationships.
  • Build strong, multilevel relationships across customer organizations, including executive sponsors, business leaders, operational stakeholders, procurement, and technology teams.
  • Establish executive sponsorship, account governance, strategic customer workshops, and regular business reviews for Esko’s most important relationships.
  • Serve as executive sponsor and deal strategist for significant opportunities, ensuring disciplined qualification, competitive positioning, negotiation, pricing, discount governance, and deal closure.
  • Orchestrate Presales, Customer Success, Product, Services, Marketing, product specialists, partners, and Esko executives around a single account strategy with clear roles and rules of engagement.
  • Partner with Customer Success to protect retention, drive adoption and customer value, identify expansion opportunities, and address account risk proactively.
  • Implement consistent operating discipline across account planning, pipeline management, opportunity progression, forecasting, CRM hygiene, and business reviews.
  • Represent the voice of strategic customers internally, using market and customer insight to inform product, packaging, services, and go-to-market priorities while balancing individual requests with Esko’s broader strategic direction.
  • Build the capabilities, methodologies, playbooks, and coaching practices required to scale a world-class strategic-account organization globally.

What We're Looking For


Minimum Qualifications


These are the must-have requirements for the role:


  • Experience leading a global enterprise sales teams in a recurring revenue B2B software environment
  • Proven track record of building and scaling high-performing sales teams that have delivered measurable ARR growth through acquisition, expansion, and customer retention
  • Demonstrated ability to design and execute multi-year account strategies across complex, multinational customer
  • Experience leading teams through complex sales cycles, including contract negotiation and deal closure at the executive level
  • Experience with CRM tools and commercial reporting, with demonstrated ability to drive accurate team forecasting and pipeline management
  • Collaborative leadership skills with demonstrated ability to coordinate and influence cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Finance, and Customer Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field

Preferred Qualifications


These are nice-to-have skills that will set candidates apart:


  • Experience selling or managing accounts within the packaging, print technology, pre-media, or digital workflow software industries
  • Background in building or transforming a Strategic Account Management function within a global software organization
  • Experience with MEDDPPIC
  • Experience with Salesforce, Gong, and an AI automated GTM tech stack
  • Experience with value selling
  • Additional language proficiency relevant to global Tier 1 account engagement

About Esko

It's all possible with a role at ​Esko ​. Esko, a ​Veralto ​ company, is a global provider of integrated software and hardware solutions that accelerate the go-to-market process of packaged goods. Our integrated platform and comprehensive tools empower retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers, and converters to manage best-in-class packaging design and print processes. Innovation is built into the DNA of our business: every day, we challenge ourselves to be better by seeking out new ways to elevate our products, our processes, and our people. We also know that innovation and ingenuity starts with prioritizing a diverse workforce and a deeply inclusive workplace. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.​​


About Veralto

At Veralto, our unifying purpose of Safeguarding the World's Most Vital Resources™ is more than words: it's a proven path towards positive change, improvement for our planet, and development for yourself. Whether we're ensuring the continued availability of clean drinking water, protecting our waterways, or enhancing the traceability, color accuracy, and packaging of everyday essentials, the work we do every day contributes to a safer world and a more sustainable future. When you join Veralto's vibrant global network of 13 operating companies and 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you'll have boundless opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career.​​

At Shepherd’s House Ministries, we believe in meeting people exactly where they are—with compassion, dignity, and grace. title: Systems Administrator
description:
Guatemala-based candidates with valid work authorization only.

Position Summary

We are looking for a Systems Administrator to join our Infrastructure team and support highly available, business-critical environments.

This role has a strong focus on F5 BIG-IP application delivery and Imperva Web Application Firewall (WAF), along with hands-on administration and support of Microsoft Windows Server and VMware vSphere environments.

The ideal candidate is a strong troubleshooter who can understand the complete application-delivery path, identify where issues are occurring, and collaborate effectively with Infrastructure, Network, Security, Database, and Application teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and troubleshoot F5 BIG-IP/LTM, including virtual servers, pools, health monitors, profiles, persistence, iRules, SSL/TLS, and certificates.
  • Administer and support Imperva WAF, including application onboarding, security policies, troubleshooting blocked requests and false positives, and policy tuning.
  • Troubleshoot application traffic across DNS, WAF, firewalls, load balancers, web/application servers, and backend services.
  • Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft Windows Server, including Active Directory-integrated environments, IIS, DNS, certificates, services, and permissions.
  • Windows Server Administration, support VMware vSphere, vCenter, ESXi, HA, DRS, vMotion, virtual machines, and clusters.
  • Support production incidents, root-cause analysis, vulnerability remediation, patching, upgrades, and infrastructure changes.
  • Participate in disaster recovery, failover testing, infrastructure monitoring, and capacity management.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, diagrams, runbooks, and recovery procedures.
  • Collaborate with Security, Network, Application, and Database teams to resolve complex infrastructure and application-delivery issues.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation as required.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of Systems Administration or Infrastructure Engineering experience. F5 and Imperva responsibilities make application delivery, web security, certificates, DNS/network troubleshooting, and escalation skills important parts of the role.
  • Hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting F5 BIG-IP/LTM.
  • Experience with Imperva WAF or comparable enterprise Web Application Firewall technologies.
  • Strong Microsoft Windows Server administration experience.
  • Experience administering VMware vSphere environments.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, certificates, and load balancing, network protocols and connectivity
  • Experience troubleshooting multi-tier enterprise applications. Disaster Recovery and Business continuity.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and ownership skills.
  • Experience HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar regulatory and security requirements is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with F5 iRules and Imperva Cloud WAF.
  • Experience with Microsoft IIS and PowerShell.
  • Experience with VMware HA, DRS, vMotion, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
  • Experience with monitoring, vulnerability management, backup, and disaster-recovery technologies.
  • Experience supporting highly available or regulated environments.
  • F5, VMware, Microsoft, or security-related certifications are a plus.

Core Competencies

Technical Troubleshooting: Able to systematically isolate problems across network, security, application-delivery, virtualization, operating-system, and application layers.

Application Delivery: Understands how enterprise applications traverse DNS, WAF, firewalls, load balancers, web servers, and backend services.

Security Awareness: Understands the security implications of infrastructure changes and balances application availability with appropriate security controls.

Ownership: Takes responsibility for technical issues through resolution rather than simply transferring problems between teams.

Change Discipline: Plans, documents, tests, and validates production changes and maintains appropriate rollback procedures.

Communication: Clearly communicates technical issues, risks, outages, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement: Identifies opportunities to automate repetitive activities, eliminate recurring incidents, improve documentation, and increase infrastructure reliability.

You should be able to follow an application request end-to-end:

Client → Firewall → Imperva WAF → F5 → Web/Application Server → Backend Services

If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems, working across technologies, and supporting critical enterprise environments, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Senior Deposit Servicing Representative
description:
The Senior Deposit Servicing Representative is responsible for performing advanced deposit servicing functions across a broad range of products and processes, including Share (Savings), Draft (Checking), Certificates, IRAs, Trust Accounts, exception management, regulatory and legal processing, and unclaimed property escheatment. This role supports members and internal business partners through multiple service channels, ensuring the timely, accurate, and compliant resolution of inquiries, transactions, and account servicing requests. Monitors daily operational activities to mitigate risk, maintain regulatory compliance, and ensure adherence to credit union policies and procedures.


As a senior subject matter expert, the role serves as a primary escalation point for complex issues involving deposit servicing, exception processing, risk controls, regulatory requirements, and account maintenance. The position applies extensive knowledge of credit union systems, NCUA regulations, federal and state requirements, and operational best practices to resolve issues and support organizational objectives.


The Senior Deposit Servicing Representative also contributes to operational excellence by identifying process improvement opportunities, supporting change initiatives, and enhancing service quality and efficiency. Success in this role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to adapt to evolving business needs, systems, and regulatory environments. Additionally, the senior may support training, coaching, and mentoring activities to strengthen team capabilities and serve as part of the development path toward a lead or supervisory position.


Key Responsibilities

Service Delivery and Member Escalation

  • Serve as the senior subject matter escalation point for complex member inquiries, multi-step servicing matters, and operational issues.
  • Review and approve large-dollar checks (> $5,000) for pay/return decisions.
  • Process chargebacks, returned items, and maintain exception reporting logs.
  • Review ATM, ITM, and mobile deposits for accuracy; initiate member outreach for exceptions.
  • Manage mobile deposit tiers and exception queues; monitor Early Federal Reserve return notifications.
  • Apply Regulation CC holds using judgment based on item risk and member history.
  • Identify and escalate suspicious or fraudulent items to Deposit Fraud and BSA teams.
  • Ensure compliance with Regulation CC, Regulation E, NACHA, UCC, Hawaii levy rules, and internal policies.
  • Resolve complex documentation discrepancies and provide subject matter guidance to the Member Solutions Center, branch teams, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Process member death notifications, conduct estate handling, coordinate with executors and personal representatives, and apply NCUA share insurance, beneficiary, and payable-on-death rules.
  • Coordinate cross-functionality with Payments, Risk, Compliance, Information Technology, and the Member Solutions Center on multi-touchpoint servicing matters that require integrated resolution.
  • Support new product launches and system implementations by representing Deposit Servicing requirements during user acceptance testing and post-launch monitoring.
  • Manage time-sensitive servicing matters that require interpretation of credit union policy, regulatory guidance, or legal documentation.

Risk Control and Fraud Mitigation

  • Manage Overdraft and Courtesy Pay programs including Courtesy Pay Negative Charge-Off Today, Courtesy Pay Exceptions, and Periodic Review of overdraft shares in alignment with credit union policy and regulatory expectations.
  • Identify control gaps in deposit servicing workflows, recommend remediation actions, and document outcomes for review by the Deposit Servicing Manager.
  • Apply Regulation CC report review procedures, document outcomes, and partner with Fraud staff on suspicious activity referrals and loss-prevention follow-through.
  • Support non-loan write-off and recovery processes co-owned with the Fraud department, ensuring restitution activity aligns with policy and controls are documented.
  • Validate and process complex disputes, chargebacks, and adjustments that exceed the Deposit Servicing Representative authority, including multi-party shared branch matters and cross-institution claims.
  • Conduct second-level review of high-risk transactions, identifying control breakdowns and recommending control enhancements to the Senior Program Manager.

Regulatory Processing and Compliance Reporting

  • Prepare and submit tax reporting and regulatory filings (1099-INT, 1099-R, 5498, 1042 IRS levy responses, IRS backup withholding) within statutory deadlines and reconcile filings against core system data.
  • Process all account restrictions, legal orders, and compliance-driven actions including Garnishments, IRS Levies, CSEA Levies, State of Hawaii Levies, and Distraint Warrants within statutory deadlines.
  • Manage escheatment and unclaimed property processes including dormancy tracking, due diligence outreach, and remittance to the State of Hawaii in accordance with Hawaii unclaimed property statute.
  • Generate compliance reporting and assist with audit, examination, and internal review requests through evidence preparation, walkthrough support, and remediation tracking.
  • Maintain examination readiness through documented controls, complete records, and timely response to NCUA, state, and external auditor requests on regulatory matters within scope.
  • Monitor regulatory and policy changes affecting assigned functions, communicate updates to Deposit Servicing I staff, and update working procedures and job aids accordingly.

Process Improvement and Automation Support

  • Support automation workflow design, user acceptance testing, exception handling, and post-implementation monitoring for Deposit Servicing-related processes including Robotic Process Automation and system-driven workflows.
  • Maintain and update standard operating procedures, job aids, and process documentation aligned with industry best-practice frameworks for deposit servicing operations.
  • Recommend technology, control, and workflow improvements to the Deposit Servicing Manager based on exception trends, member feedback, and operational metrics.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects including new product launches, system implementations, and regulatory change initiatives as Deposit Servicing subject matter expert.

Coaching and Knowledge Transfer

  • Coach Deposit Servicing staff on advanced servicing scenarios, procedural exceptions, and regulatory interpretation during the course of daily operations.
  • Support new hire training, contribute to job aid development, and participate in onboarding for newly transitioned work from branches and other departments.
  • Document tribal knowledge in accessible standard work and reference materials to accelerate Deposit Servicing Representative ramp time and reduce single-points-of-failure on critical processes.
  • Provide subject matter guidance to peer departments on Deposit Servicing capabilities, constraints, and integration touchpoints during cross-functional initiatives.

Deposit Processing

  • Oversee daily check deposits and payments received via mail and internal sources.
  • Post draft items and prepare files for Federal Reserve transmission.
  • Process stop payments, account adjustments, and specialized transactions with proper authorization.
  • Complete check adjustments and coordinate with external institutions for resolution.

Account and Records Maintenance

  • Perform updates for address, name, SSN, and verify documentation for accuracy.
  • Complete Verification of Deposit and income verification requests.
  • Reactivate dormant accounts with CIP and OFAC checks.
  • Support online banking maintenance and follow up on returned payments.
  • Assist front-line staff with trust account setup and documentation review.
  • Support trust account setup by reviewing documentation and guiding front-line staff.

Document Imaging

  • Scan, index, and verify member documents to maintain imaging standards.
  • Oversee the destruction and purging process for paper and electronic records that fall under Deposit Servicing while adhering to Internal record retention requirements and external regulations.

Mail and Courier Processing

  • Sort and process incoming/outgoing USPS mail, remittance payments, and return mail.
  • Sort courier bags and resolve discrepancies.

Workflow and Leadership Support

  • Serve as backup to the manager for workflow coordination during peak periods or absences.
  • Monitor cutoffs, distribute work, and ensure SLA completion.
  • Create and update job aids and standard operating procedures.
  • Support new hire training and coach team members on complex items.
  • Recommend improvements for automation, risk control, and service quality.

Exception Management and Operational Oversight

  • Conduct exceptions monitoring and reporting across the established report inventory, including Certificate Errors and Exceptions, Mail Code Exception Report, Rate Exception Report, Maturity Disbursement Exception Report, Closed Share Activity Report, New Share Activity Exception Report, Box Report Exceptions, and the New Share Activity Audit Report
  • Monitor cutoffs, distribute work, and ensure service-level completion during peak periods or absences; serve as backup to the Deposit Servicing Manager for workflow coordination
  • Generate operational reports, contribute insights to performance dashboards, and translate exception trends into improvement recommendations.
  • Process specialized back-office items including A9 transactions, certificate maintenance exceptions, and complex account corrections in accordance with documented procedures.
  • Reconcile high-volume operational accounts, resolve aged variances in collaboration with Finance and Accounting, and document outcomes for audit support.

Performance Expectations

  • Complete assigned tasks within daily deadlines while maintaining high accuracy.
  • Maintain confidentiality and adhere to all credit union policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Demonstrate independence, accountability, and contribute to team success.


Competencies

  • Member Focus
  • Collaborating with Others
  • Fostering Communication
  • Quality Focus
  • Problem Solving
  • Digital Literacy
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Agility
  • Attention to Detail
  • Information Gathering and Processing
  • Initiative
  • Planning and Organizing


Job Skills

  • Microsoft Office 365 applications
  • Banking Regulations
  • Fraud Detection and Control
  • Technical Writing
  • Time Management
  • Fostering Learning and Development
  • Project Management
  • Product and Technical Knowledge
  • Risk Management Practices

Qualifications & Experience

  • Demonstrated experience handling exception items, legal processing, regulatory filings (tax, escheatment, levies), or estate and trust matters within a regulated financial institution.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

  • Three to four years of experience in financial services with demonstrated breadth across deposit servicing, payments, exception management, or compliance functions preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience coaching peers, contributing to process improvement or automation initiatives, and supporting audit and examination activity is strongly preferred.
  • No certifications required; relevant credit union and banking certifications (e.g., NCCO, BSACS, CUNA-CUCE, NCP) are valued and encouraged with the credit union’s support.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Business bachelor's degree or related field preferred; equivalent professional experience considered.

Minimum Physical Requirements

  • Sitting for prolonged periods at a desk working on a computer.
  • Standing and walking for short periods of time frequently.
  • Walking on occasion for less than 1 hour per day.
  • Reaching, bending, twisting, turning frequently.
  • Lifting, pulling, pushing, and carrying up to 30 pounds on occasion.
  • We'll make reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants and employees with disabilities.


Benefits and Pay

The expected pay for the Senior Deposit Servicing Representative position is $25.00 to $30.00 per hour.


This pay reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer for this role based on typical qualifications and market data. Offered pay may vary depending on the candidate’s experience, skills, and other relevant factors.


We cover 100% of employees’ single medical, drug, vision, and dental monthly health insurance premiums. Employees also love receiving paid volunteer time and our pay it forward program. Tuition assistance for higher education is another special way we invest in our workforce. Benefits include, Paid Time Off and 11 Paid Holidays, 401(k) and 3% Employer Contribution, Health insurance, Paid time off, Vision insurance, Dental insurance, Prescription drug insurance, Tuition reimbursement, Life insurance, Flexible spending account, Disability insurance, Opportunities for advancement, Employee assistance program, Referral program, Retirement plan, Employee discount, Paid training, Professional development assistance, AD&D insurance, Volunteer time off, Credit union membership, Paid orientation, and more.


About Company

HawaiiUSA Federal Credit Union is a local, not-for-profit, federally insured financial cooperative, owned and operated by our members since 1936. We are dedicated to helping members achieve their financial goals and our employees reach their career aspirations. We are committed to our community by extending ourselves through our time, efforts and resources. Our motto, Life Matters, means celebrating life’s experiences and creating fulfilling work opportunities, not just jobs.


Make a difference one life at a time!


Monday to Friday: 8:15 AM to 5 PM. Expect a modified schedule that includes all the Saturdays in a month 3-4 times per year on Saturday 8:15 AM to 1:30 PM. On occasion as early as 8 AM or as late as 5:30 PM.
Approximately 40 hours per week.
